title: COLLATERAL EMBOLIZATION IN THE ENDOVASCULAR TREATMENT OF PORTAL CAVERNOMA CHOLANGIOPATHY: A POTENTIAL CAUSE OF SEVERE BILIARY OBSTRUCTION.
abstract: Management of complicated portal cavernoma cholangiopathy (PCC) remains nonstandardized. When biliary drainage fails, portal vein recanalization with transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (PVR-TIPS) is increasingly considered and may require collateral embolization during the procedure. This work describes two patients with complicated PCC in whom collateral embolization during or after PVR-TIPS caused severe biliary obstruction requiring long-term biliary drainage. A narrative review was conducted, identifying 18 published studies describing patients with PCC who underwent endovascular treatment. Collateral embolization was inconsistently reported, and its biliary consequences were rarely described. Severe biliary obstruction following peribiliary collateral embolization may therefore be an underrecognized complication; however, its incidence remains unknown based on the available literature. Thus, when collateral embolization is considered during endovascular treatment of PCC, its potential biliary risk should be weighed, and the anatomical relationship between the targeted collaterals and the bile duct carefully assessed.

summary.title_ko: 간동맥동굴병 담즙염증증의 혈관내 치료 시 담 collateral 혈관 색전술: 심각한 담즙 폐쇄의 잠재적 원인
summary.one_line: 간동맥동굴병 담즙염증증(PCC) 환자의 혈관내 치료 중 collateral 혈관 색전술이 심각한 담즙 폐쇄를 유발할 수 있으며, 이 합병증은 과소평가될 가능성이 있다.
summary.design: 증례 보고 (Case Report) 및 문헌 고찰 (Narrative Review)
summary.subjects: PCC 환자 2명 (문헌 고찰: 18편의 연구, 총 환자 수 불명)
summary.intervention: 간동맥동굴병(portal cavernoma) 환자의 담즙 배액 실패 시, 경정맥내 간-체계 정맥 단락술(transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt, PVR-TIPS) 시행 후 collateral 혈관 색전술(collateral embolization)
summary.results: 2명의 PCC 환자에서 PVR-TIPS 시술 중 또는 시술 후 collateral 혈관 색전술로 인해 심각한 담즙 폐쇄가 발생하여 장기적인 담즙 배액이 필요했으며, 문헌 고찰 결과 collateral 혈관 색전술의 담즙 관련 합병증은 거의 보고되지 않았다.
summary.implication: PCC 환자의 혈관내 치료 시 collateral 혈관 색전술을 고려할 때, 잠재적인 담즙 관련 위험을 평가하고, 표적 collateral 혈관과 담관의 해부학적 관계를 신중하게 고려해야 한다.
summary.detailed_results: 문헌 고찰에서 collateral 혈관 색전술에 대한 보고는 일관되지 않았으며, 담즙 관련 합병증에 대한 정보는 매우 제한적이었다. collateral 혈관 색전술 후 발생한 심각한 담즙 폐쇄의 발생률은 현재까지 알려진 바 없다.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 증례 보고와 문헌 고찰의 한계를 가지고 있으며, collateral 혈관 색전술의 실제 발생률에 대한 정확한 수치를 제공하지 못한다. 기존 연구에서 collateral 혈관 색전술의 담즙 관련 합병증에 대한 정보가 부족하여, 본 연구 결과의 일반화에는 주의가 필요하다.
summary.clinical_application: PCC 환자의 혈관내 치료 계획 수립 시 collateral 혈관 색전술의 잠재적 위험-이익을 신중하게 평가하고, 담관과의 해부학적 관계를 면밀히 확인하여 불필요한 담즙 폐쇄를 예방해야 한다.  PVR-TIPS 시술 전후 담즙 배출 상태를 주의 깊게 모니터링하고, 담즙 폐쇄 발생 시 신속하게 대처해야 한다.

title: Stent Configurations in Aortoiliac Occlusive disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate which endovascular stent configuration at the aortic bifurcation offers superior outcomes for aorto-iliac occlusive disease (AIOD). METHODS: Studies reporting outcomes for endovascular reconstruction for AIOD, for TransAtlantic Inter-Society Consensus (TASC) C and D lesions were included in the review. Data for primary, primary-assisted and secondary patency were extracted (full-text articles or reconstructed from published Kaplan Meier curves). RESULTS: This review included 12 studies, including 1027 patients (177 Covered Endovascular Reconstruction of the Aortic Bifurcation (CERAB), 850 kissing stent). Most studies were retrospective cohort studies with moderate methodological quality. Median follow-up was 20 months for primary patency, and 48 months for assisted and secondary patency. CERAB and kissing stent techniques showed similar primary patency (p=0.24). Primary-assisted patency was slightly lower for CERAB but not statistically significant (p=0.051). Secondary patency favored CERAB (p=0.045). At two years, CERAB had primary patency of 90%, primary-assisted patency of 87%, and secondary patency of 100%. Kissing stents showed primary patency of 91%, primary-assisted patency of 92%, and secondary patency of 96%. CONCLUSION: Both stent types yielded positive results, but current data does not favor one configuration. Current studies on this topic are low quality. At present, the method of endovascular intervention for AIOD could be left to clinical expertise, although hemodynamic studies may provide insights. Randomized trial data or post-market registries are needed to ascertain superiority of any stent configuration in this disease process.
authors: Configurations In Aortoiliac Occlusive Disease Stent

summary.title_ko: 대동맥-둔장 폐색 질환에서 스텐트 구성: 체계적 검토 및 메타분석

title: Comparative Effectiveness and Safety of Treatments and Embolic Agents for Symptomatic Uterine Fibroids: A Bayesian Network Meta-analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: To compare, using Bayesian network meta-analysis, the effectiveness and safety of treatments and embolic agents for symptomatic uterine fibroids. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A PRISMA-compliant systematic review of randomized controlled trials (PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library; inception through July 2026) compared, via two prespecified Bayesian network meta-analyses, (1) uterine artery embolization (UAE) with hysterectomy, myomectomy, magnetic resonance-guided focused ultrasound, microwave ablation, and laparoscopic uterine artery occlusion, and (2) embolic agents used during UAE. Primary outcomes were technical success and major complications for treatment strategies, and complete/near-complete fibroid infarction for embolic agents; reintervention was secondary in both networks. RESULTS: Twenty-three RCTs (N=2,055 women) were included. Technical success and major complication rates did not differ significantly across treatment strategies or embolic agents in the Bayesian analysis, though frequentist analysis showed slightly higher technical success with hysterectomy than UAE (RR, 1.09; 95% CI, 1.02-1.17). Myomectomy had significantly lower reintervention than UAE (OR, 0.21; 95% CrI, 0.10-0.40). Several Bayesian associations emerged for polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) particles versus tris-acryl gelatin microspheres (TAGM), including higher complete infarction (OR, 4.8; 95% CrI, 1.0-40), higher reintervention (OR, 5.3; 95% CrI, 1.4-28), and divergent findings with PVA700-900; none was reproduced in the frequentist analysis. CONCLUSION: UAE did not differ significantly from alternative strategies in procedural success or safety, but myomectomy showed greater durability. Evidence is insufficient to establish definitive embolic-agent differences. Treatment strategy appears to influence outcomes more than embolic material, supporting individualized selection and larger trials.

summary.title_ko: 증상성 자궁근종 치료법 및 혈전색제 효과 비교: 베이지안 네트워크 메타분석
summary.one_line: 자궁근종 치료에서 자궁동맥혈전색술(UAE)은 다른 치료법과 유의미한 차이를 보이지 않았으며, 자궁근절술(Myomectomy)은 재수술률이 낮았으나, 혈전색제 간의 차이는 명확하지 않았습니다.
summary.design: PRISMA 가이드라인 준수 체계적 문헌고찰 및 베이지안 네트워크 메타분석 (RCT)
summary.intervention: 자궁동맥혈전색술(UAE), 자궁전절제술(Hysterectomy), 자궁근절술(Myomectomy), 자기공명영상유도집중초음파(Magnetic Resonance-guided Focused Ultrasound), 마이크로파 열전기소멸술(Microwave Ablation), 경식도 자궁동맥 폐색술(Laparoscopic Uterine Artery Occlusion), 폴리비닐알코올(PVA) 입자, 트리스-아크릴 젤라틴 미세구(TAGM)
summary.results:
- 치료 전략 간 기술적 성공률 및 주요 합병증 발생률은 베이지안 분석에서 유의미한 차이를 보이지 않았습니다. 빈도주의 분석에서는 자궁전절제술이 UAE보다 기술적 성공률이 약간 더 높았습니다 (상대 위험도(RR), 1.09; 95% 신뢰구간(CI), 1.02-1.17).
- 자궁근절술은 UAE보다 재수술률이 유의미하게 낮았습니다 (오즈비(OR), 0.21; 95% 신뢰구간(CrI), 0.10-0.40).
- 폴리비닐알코올(PVA) 입자와 트리스-아크릴 젤라틴 미세구(TAGM) 간의 베이지안 연관성이 나타났으며, 완전 괴사율 증가 (오즈비(OR), 4.8; 95% 신뢰구간(CrI), 1.0-40), 재수술률 증가 (오즈비(OR), 5.3; 95% 신뢰구간(CrI), 1.4-28) 등이 관찰되었으나, 빈도주의 분석에서는 재현되지 않았습니다.
summary.implication: 자궁근종 치료 전략 선택 시 환자 맞춤형 접근 방식이 중요하며, 더 큰 규모의 임상 시험을 통해 혈전색제 간의 차이를 명확히 할 필요가 있습니다. 치료 전략이 혈전색제 종류보다 결과에 더 큰 영향을 미치는 것으로 보입니다.

title: Percutaneous Recanalization of Chronic Noncirrhotic Native-Liver Extrahepatic Portal Vein Obstruction in Children.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate technical success, procedure-related safety, and imaging-based patency of percutaneous portal vein recanalization (PVR) in children with chronic native-liver extrahepatic portal vein obstruction (EHPVO). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 28 consecutive patients younger than 17 years with chronic noncirrhotic, nonmalignant EHPVO who underwent attempted PVR between 2016 and 2026. Recanalization was performed through transhepatic, transsplenic, or combined access, followed by balloon angioplasty without stenting. Technical success was defined as restoration of hepatopetal flow through the portal vein into the intrahepatic portal venous system. Adverse events were graded using the Society of Interventional Radiology classification. Portal vein patency was assessed on available follow-up imaging. RESULTS: Technical success was achieved in 19 of 28 patients (67.9%). Six patients (21.4%) had access-related adverse events (3 mild, 1 moderate, 2 severe), with no surgery, permanent sequelae, or procedure-related death. Follow-up imaging was available for 15 of 19 technically successful patients, with a median imaging follow-up of 11 months (range, 1-35 months). At last imaging, the portal vein was patent without significant restenosis in 7 patients, patent with restenosis in 5, and reoccluded in 3. Overall, portal venous flow was maintained in 12 of 15 patients (80.0%). CONCLUSION: Percutaneous PVR restored hepatopetal portal flow in 67.9% of selected children without stenting. Durable patency could not be established because follow-up was incomplete and heterogeneous. Restenosis and reocclusion support structured imaging surveillance; further studies should define the role of stenting versus angioplasty alone.

summary.title_ko: 소아의 만성 비간견성, 간외 문맥 폐쇄에 대한 경피적 문맥 재관류술
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 만성 비간견성, 간외 문맥 폐쇄를 가진 소아 환자에서 경피적 문맥 재관류술(Percutaneous Portal Vein Recanalization, PVR)의 기술적 성공률, 시술 관련 안전성, 영상 기반 관류 유지를 평가한 결과, 67.9%의 기술적 성공률을 보였으나, 장기적인 관류 유지는 제한적이었다.
summary.design: 후향적 단일 센터 연구 (Retrospective Single-Center Study)
summary.subjects: 만 17세 미만 소아 환자 28명 (N=28) - 만성 비간견성, 비악성 간외 문맥 폐쇄 환자
summary.intervention: 경피적 문맥 재관류술(PVR) - 경간막, 경비장 또는 병합 접근을 통해 시행, 스텐트 없이 풍선 확장술(Balloon Angioplasty) 시행
summary.results: 기술적 성공률: 28명 중 19명 (67.9%). 시술 관련 부작용: 6명 (21.4%) - 경미 3건, 중등도 1건, 중증 2건.  영상 추적 관류 유지: 기술적으로 성공한 19명 중 15명에서 추적 영상 가능. 중앙 추적 기간 11개월 (1-35개월 범위). 마지막 영상 시점: 문맥 개통 유지 (significant restenosis 없음) 7명, 개통 유지 (restenosis 있음) 5명, 재폐색 3명. 전체적으로 15명 중 12명 (80.0%)에서 문맥 혈류 유지.
summary.implication: 경피적 문맥 재관류술(PVR)은 스텐트 없이도 선택된 소아 환자에서 간쪽 문맥 혈류를 회복하는 데 효과적일 수 있다. 하지만, 장기적인 관류 유지를 위해 구조화된 영상 추적 관찰이 필요하며, 스텐트 사용 여부에 대한 추가 연구가 필요하다.

title: A Branch-Specific Combined Fenestration Strategy for Chronic Aortic Dissection With Severe Paravisceral True Lumen Compression.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate a branch-specific combined fenestration strategy to address the technical challenges of severe true lumen (TL) compression during physician-modified fenestration (PMF)-based four-vessel visceral reconstruction in chronic aortic dissection (CAD). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study enrolled twenty-three consecutive patients with aneurysmal CAD and severe paravisceral TL compression (minimum functional TL diameter ≤10 mm) treated between January 2020 and December 2024. All patients underwent visceral reconstruction using anterior-branch PMF and bilateral renal in situ laser fenestration (ISLF) performed following TL expansion. Endpoints included technical success (complete four-vessel reconstruction), 30-day mortality, target-vessel patency, and TL expansion. RESULTS: Complete four-vessel visceral reconstruction was achieved in all 23 patients (92/92 target vessels). Renal ISLF was successful in all 46 renal arteries, with first-attempt success in 44 (96%). Distal aortic exclusion was required in 20 patients; one interval infrarenal rupture in the staged group was managed with emergency repair. Over a median follow-up of 17.0 months, primary target-vessel patency was 99% (91/92). The median minimum functional TL diameter increased from 8.0 mm preoperatively to 15.9 mm at one-year follow-up. No type I or III endoleak was identified. Thirty-day mortality was 0%. Transient spinal cord ischaemia occurred in one patient (4%), and acute kidney injury (KDIGO Stage 1) in two patients (9%), all resolving before discharge. CONCLUSION: In highly selected CAD patients with severe TL compression, this combined fenestration strategy enabled complete four-vessel visceral reconstruction with satisfactory early target-vessel patency and no target-vessel loss, though longer follow-up in larger cohorts is required.

summary.title_ko: 만성 대동맥 박리 환자의 심각한 부위간(paravisceral) 진정한 혈관(true lumen) 압박에 대한 분지별(branch-specific) 결합형(combined) 창문술(fenestration) 전략 평가
summary.one_line: 만성 대동맥 박리 환자의 심각한 진정한 혈관 압박 상황에서 분지별 창문술과 신장 내 위치 레이저 창문술을 결합한 전략이 완전한 4혈관 복구와 우수한 초기 혈관 개통률을 달성하는 데 효과적임을 보여준다.
summary.subjects: 대상: 만성 대동맥 박리(CAD) 환자 23명 (N=23), 심각한 부위간 진정한 혈관 압박 (최소 기능적 진정한 혈관 직경 ≤10 mm)
summary.intervention: 분지별 전방 창문술(anterior-branch PMF, physician-modified fenestration) 및 양측 신장 내 위치 레이저 창문술(ISLF, in situ laser fenestration)을 시행하여 진정한 혈관 확장 후 4혈관 복구를 진행
summary.results: 기술적 성공률: 23명 중 23명 (92/92 목표 혈관)에서 완전한 4혈관 복구 달성. 신장 ISLF 성공률: 46개 신장 동맥 중 44개 (96%)에서 첫 시도 성공. 20명에서 분문 배제(distal aortic exclusion) 필요. 중간 추적 기간: 17.0개월. 1차 목표 혈관 개통률: 99% (91/92). 수술 전 최소 기능적 진정한 혈관 직경: 8.0 mm에서 1년 추적 관찰 시 15.9 mm로 증가. Type I 또는 III 내출혈(endoleak) 없음. 30일 사망률: 0%. 일시적 척수 허혈(transient spinal cord ischaemia): 1명 (4%). 급성 신장 손상(KDIGO Stage 1): 2명 (9%), 모두 퇴원 전 호전.
summary.implication: 심각한 진정한 혈관 압박을 가진 엄선된 만성 대동맥 박리 환자에게 이 결합형 창문술 전략은 완전한 4혈관 복구와 만족스러운 초기 목표 혈관 개통률을 가능하게 하지만, 더 큰 규모의 환자군에서 장기적인 추적 관찰이 필요하다.

title: Embolization versus Nephrectomy in Hemodynamically Stable Patients with American Association for the Surgery of Trauma Grade III-V Blunt Kidney Injuries: Association with Lower Rates of Acute Kidney Injury and In-Hospital Mortality.
abstract: PURPOSE: To compare rates of acute kidney injury (AKI) and in-hospital mortality between embolization and nephrectomy in hemodynamically stable patients with American Association for the Surgery of Trauma (AAST) Grade III-V blunt kidney injuries. MATERIALS AND METHODS: All cases of blunt AAST Grade III-V kidney injuries from 2017 to 2022 were identified using the American College of Surgeons Trauma Quality Improvement Program database. Cases with initial hypotension (systolic blood pressure, <90 mmHg), length of stay <24 hours, nonsurvivable injuries (any abbreviated injury score of 6), and transfers were excluded. Multivariable logistic regression was utilized to assess the effect of embolization on in-hospital mortality and AKI. Inverse propensity weighting with regression adjustment was used, adjusting for gender, hospital characteristics, vital signs, Glasgow Coma Scale score, injury severity score, and grade of kidney injury. Of 849 patients, 74.4% were male, median age was 37 years (interquartile range, 24-57 years), and injury grade distribution rates were 15% Grade III, 44% Grade IV, and 41% Grade V. RESULTS: Of 849 cases of blunt AAST Grade III-V kidney injuries, 469 (55%) underwent embolization, and 380 (45%) underwent nephrectomy. On adjusted analysis, nephrectomy was associated with a 5.0% absolute increase in AKI (relative risk [RR], 2.22; P < .001) and a 7.2% absolute increase in in-hospital mortality (RR, 2.47; P < .001) compared with embolization. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates that embolization is associated with both lower likelihood of AKI and mortality than nephrectomy in initially hemodynamically stable patients with blunt trauma and high-grade kidney injuries. A kidney-preservation strategy with embolization may be considered for initial management of these patients, although future prospective work is needed to validate these findings.

title: One-Year Outcomes and Additive Risk of Restenosis After Rotational Atherectomy Plus Drug-Coated Balloon Angioplasty for Calcified Femoropopliteal Lesions in a Japanese Population.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate 1-year clinical outcomes and identify predictors of restenosis after rotational atherectomy and drug-coated balloon (DCB) angioplasty for calcified femoropopliteal lesions. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective, multicenter, single-arm study included 241 patients (178 men [73.9%] and 63 women [26.1%]) treated with JETSTREAM atherectomy and DCB angioplasty at eight Japanese centers. Mean lesion length was 16.5 cm, 28.6% were chronic total occlusions, and 91.3% had PACSS grade 3/4 calcification. Primary patency was freedom from restenosis (duplex ultrasonography-derived peak systolic velocity ratio >2.4 or occlusion) and clinically driven target lesion revascularization (CD-TLR). At 1 year, 220 patients (91.3%) completed follow-up. RESULTS: One-year primary patency and freedom from CD-TLR were 85.5% and 91.3%, respectively. Exploratory multivariable analysis identified hemodialysis (HR 2.70, 95% CI 1.27-5.77, P = 0.01), chronic total occlusion (HR 2.85, 95% CI 1.39-5.83, P < 0.01), prior endovascular therapy (HR 5.08, 95% CI 2.48-10.4, P < 0.01), and popliteal artery involvement (HR 3.62, 95% CI 1.76-7.46, P < 0.01) as independently associated with patency loss. Patency declined from 94.1% with ≤1 factor to 38.1% with ≥3 factors. Neither severe nor nodular calcifications were associated with patency loss. Among restenotic lesions, 54.8% were occlusive, and shorter than baseline lesions. Angiographic distal embolization occurred in 37.8% and remained unresolved in 3.3%. CONCLUSION: One-year primary patency was 85.5%. Exploratory analyses suggested an additive association between clinical and anatomical factors and loss of patency. These findings require confirmation given the single-arm design and limited number of patency-loss events.

"CLEAN-UP AV": A composite interventional technique for treating Perianastomotic Arteriovenous Fistula dysfunction with balloon angioplasty: A 10-year outcome analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate long-term outcomes of a standardized interventional protocol, CLEAN-UP AV, for managing perianastomotic segment (PAS) stenosis or occlusion in dysfunctional arteriovenous fistulas (AVFs). METHODS: This retrospective single center focused PAS angioplasty cohort from a tertiary referral practice analyzed 553 AVF angioplasties performed in 457 patients over 10 years. The CLEAN-UP AV strategy incorporates: advanced Crossing techniques, Lumen gain with appropriate balloons, treatment of the Entire circuit, Anastomotic dilation via optimal Access, No residual waist, procedural Ultrasound guidance, and postprocedural Pharmacotherapy. Angioplasty was performed using either U or V configuration technique: U angioplasty referring to angioplasty performed from artery to vein or from vein to artery and V angioplasty referring to sequential balloon angioplasty of the arterial and venous segments, including the anastomosis. Technical and clinical success, primary and secondary patency, adverse events, and predictors of patency loss were assessed. RESULTS: Technical success was achieved in 94.4% of procedures. Kaplan-Meier estimated 1 to 5 year primary and secondary patency rates in technically successful cases were 78%, 70%, 62%, 61%, and 58% and 89%, 84%, 83%, 80%, and 80%, respectively. On multivariable Cox proportional hazards analysis, radiocephalic fistula configuration was an independent predictor of superior primary and secondary patency while hypothyroidism and high-pressure balloon requirement were independently associated with inferior primary patency. Major adverse event rate was 1.6%. CONCLUSION: In this single-center retrospective cohort, angioplasty performed using the CLEAN-UP AV approach was associated with high technical success and favorable long-term primary and secondary patency for perianastomotic AVF dysfunction.

summary.implication: CLEAN-UP AV 기법은 주변 동정맥루 기능 부전 치료에 높은 기술적 성공률과 우수한 장기적인 개통율을 제공하며, 방사선-척동맥 동정맥루 구성은 유리한 영향을 미치는 반면, 갑상선 기능 저하증 및 고압 풍선 사용은 주의가 필요하다.

title: Comprehensive Evaluation of Hemodialysis Arteriovenous Fistula Dysfunction Using 2D-Ultrasound, Elastography, and Vector Flow Imaging.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the diagnostic value of multimodal ultrasound-including 2D-ultrasound, sound touch elastography (STE), and vector flow imaging (VFI)-for the identification of functional and biomechanical abnormalities indicative of arteriovenous fistula (AVF) stenosis or occlusion in hemodialysis patients. METHODS: This prospective study enrolled 37 hemodialysis patients with AVFs, divided into normal (n = 20) and dysfunction (n = 17) groups based on digital subtraction angiography (DSA) or clinical/ultrasound criteria. For the dysfunction group, AVF stenosis was defined as >50% luminal diameter reduction on DSA, and occlusion as complete absence of flow. For the normal group, dysfunction was excluded by clinical examination (thrill/bruit) and normal duplex parameters. All patients underwent 2D-ultrasound, STE, and VFI examinations. Key parameters measured included vessel diameter, elasticity (kPa), blood flow velocities, turbulence index, and wall shear stress (WSS). Statistical comparisons were made between groups. RESULTS: No significant differences were found in vessel diameter or intima status between groups. However, the stenosis/occlusion group exhibited significantly lower mean blood flow, peak systolic/end-diastolic velocities, and WSS, along with higher resistance index and vessel wall stiffness (STE-mean: 30.35 ± 11.65 vs. 20.7 ± 7.52 kPa, p < 0.01). VFI revealed reduced blood flow velocity, turbulence, and WSS in dysfunctional AVFs (all p < 0.01). CONCLUSION: Multimodal ultrasound integrating 2D-ultrasound, STE, and VFI provides a comprehensive assessment of AVF structure and function, detecting functional and biomechanical abnormalities associated with AVF stenosis or occlusion.

Efficacy and Safety of Bridging Intravenous Thrombolysis in the "Drip-and-Ship" Model for Anterior and Posterior Circulation Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: The drip-and-ship paradigm extends access to endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) from primary stroke centers (PSC), particularly where comprehensive stroke centers (CSC) are limited, but transfer may delay reperfusion. We evaluated the efficacy and safety of intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) before transfer for EVT in patients with large vessel occlusion (LVO) stroke. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library through March 2026 for studies comparing IVT versus no IVT in patients transferred from PSC to CSC for EVT consideration. Random-effects models were used for pooled analyses. Heterogeneity was quantified by I2 and prediction intervals (PI). RESULTS: Sixteen observational studies involving 5,488 patients were included. In anterior circulation stroke, IVT was associated with higher odds of functional independence (mRS 0-2; aOR 1.76; P=0.02; 95% PI 0.67-4.63, including the null) and lower 90-day mortality (aOR 0.52; P<0.0001). In posterior circulation stroke, IVT was associated with lower mortality (RR 0.74; P=0.04), but not improved functional outcomes. IVT was associated with higher early recanalization during transfer in anterior (RR 5.24; P<0.0001) and posterior circulation (RR 17.46; P<0.0001), without significant differences in post-EVT revascularization or intracranial hemorrhage. All included studies were observational, and certainty of GRADE evidence was very low. CONCLUSION: IVT before transfer was associated with higher early recanalization and favorable clinical outcomes, particularly in anterior circulation stroke, without a detected increase in intracranial hemorrhage. Given the very-low certainty of evidence, these findings should be interpreted cautiously. Identified methodological limitations also informed considerations for future research.

Inferior Vena Cava Filters in Adolescents with Thromboembolic Disease: Technical Outcomes, Retrieval, and the Role of Skeletal Maturity.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate technical success, periprocedural safety and retrieval outcomes of inferior vena cava filter (IVCF) placement in adolescents with venous thromboembolism and to determine whether retrieval failure is associated with skeletal maturity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Single-center retrospective review of 26 IVCF placed in 25 patients with iliocaval or iliofemoral thrombosis (mean age 15.8 ± 2.2 years; range 9-18) between 2006 and 2024. Skeletal maturity was graded by Risser stage. Retrieval was attempted once the initial indication had resolved and anticoagulation was feasible. RESULTS: Implantation succeeded in every case; mean caval diameter was 17.9 ± 3.0 mm. Retrieval was attempted in 22 of 26 filters and succeeded in 19 (86% of attempts, 79% by intent to retrieve, 73% overall). One successful retrieval required a second attempt with an adjunctive loop-snare maneuver. Median indwelling time was 89 days (range 1-489). All three unsuccessful retrievals occurred at Risser stage 3 or below (3 of 7 versus 0 of 15 attempted; P = .02), not explained by caval diameter (P = .33). Seven filters (27%) remained in situ. No periprocedural adverse events occurred. Both retained filters assessed by CT showed caval wall penetration, one with strut fracture and asymptomatic migration at 16 years; chronic caval occlusion developed in one patient. CONCLUSION: Off-label IVCF placement in adolescents achieved high technical and retrieval success. Retrieval failure was confined to skeletally immature patients and was not explained by caval diameter. Strut fracture with migration at long-term imaging reinforces the need for timely retrieval.

summary.title_ko: 청소년의 혈전색전증 환자에서 하대정맥필터(IVCF) 삽입술: 기술적 성과, 회수, 그리고 골격 성숙의 역할
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 혈전색전증을 앓고 있는 청소년 환자에서 하대정맥필터(IVCF) 삽입술의 기술적 성공률, 안전성, 회수율을 평가하고 골격 성숙이 회수 실패와 관련이 있는지 확인한 결과, 골격이 덜 성숙한 환자에서 회수 실패가 주로 발생함을 확인했습니다.
summary.subjects: 25명의 환자 (총 26개의 하대정맥필터(IVCF), 평균 연령 15.8 ± 2.2세, 범위 9-18세)
summary.intervention: 하대정맥필터(IVCF) 삽입술 (iliocaval 또는 iliofemoral 혈전증 환자 대상)
summary.results: 모든 삽입술에서 기술적 성공을 보였으며, 평균 대정맥 직경은 17.9 ± 3.0 mm였습니다. 26개의 필터 중 22개(86% of attempts, intent to retrieve 기준 79%, 전체 73%)에서 회수가 성공했습니다. 회수 성공을 위해 보조 루프-올가리(loop-snare) 기법이 한 번 사용되었습니다. 필터 삽입 유지 시간 중앙값은 89일 (범위 1-489일)이었으며, Risser stage 3 이하의 골격 미성숙 환자에서 회수 실패가 발생했습니다 (7/7 환자 vs. 15/15 환자, P = .02). 대정맥 직경은 회수 실패와 관련이 없었습니다 (P = .33). 7개의 필터(27%)가 삽입 위치에 남아있었고, CT 검사 결과 대정맥 벽 침범이 관찰되었으며, 한 필터에서 스트럿 골절과 16세 시점의 무증상 이동이 확인되었습니다. 한 명의 환자는 만성 대정맥 폐색을 개발했습니다.
summary.implication: 청소년 환자에서 하대정맥필터(IVCF) 삽입술은 높은 기술적 성공률과 회수율을 보이지만, 골격 성숙 정도에 따라 회수 실패 위험이 달라질 수 있습니다. 따라서 골격이 덜 성숙한 환자에서는 필터 회수를 위한 주의가 필요하며, 장기적인 추적 관찰을 통해 스트럿 골절 및 이동 여부를 확인하고 적절한 시기에 필터 회수를 고려해야 합니다.

title: Feasibility, Safety, and Effectiveness of Bleomycin Electrosclerotherapy in Patients with "Giant Hepatic Hemangiomas".
abstract: This retrospective study evaluated the feasibility, safety, and effectiveness of bleomycin electrosclerotherapy (BEST) in nine patients with symptomatic, size-progressive "giant hepatic hemangiomas" unsuitable for surgery. BEST was performed under general anesthesia using six CT-guided needle electrodes. Bleomycin was administered intravenously in three patients and intralesionally in six (3,000-16,430 IU). Follow-up MRI was recommended three months after treatment. Median volume reduction at first follow-up was 18.3% (IQR, 2.7%-36.2%; P = .020) at a median of 77 days (IQR, 44-117 days). Extended follow-up in eight patients demonstrated a median volume reduction of 47.0% (IQR, 17.5%-73.2%; P = .016) at 299 days (IQR, 256-739 days). Six of nine patients reported symptom improvement during follow-up. No major complications occurred; adverse events included three asymptomatic perihepatic hematomas and one intercostal neuralgia requiring prolonged analgesic treatment. BEST was feasible and associated with lesion volume reduction and symptom improvement in this cohort. LEVEL OF EVIDENCE: Level 4, Case Series.

summary.title_ko: 거대 간혈종(Giant Hepatic Hemangiomas) 환자에서 블레오마이신 전기경화술(Bleomycin Electrosclerotherapy, BEST)의 실용성, 안전성 및 효과성 평가
summary.one_line: 수술이 불가능한 거대 간혈종 환자에게 블레오마이신 전기경화술(BEST)은 안전하고 효과적으로 병변 용적 감소 및 증상 완화를 가져올 수 있다.
summary.subjects: 9명의 거대 간혈종 환자 (N=9)
summary.intervention: 전신(intravenous) 블레오마이신 투여 3명, 병변 내(intralesional) 블레오마이신 투여 6명 (3,000-16,430 IU), CT-가이드 하에 6개의 전극을 이용한 전기경화술(Electrosclerotherapy)
summary.results: 최초 추적 MRI에서 병변 용적 감소는 중앙값 18.3% (IQR, 2.7%-36.2%; P = .020)였으며, 추적 기간 중앙값은 77일 (IQR, 44-117일)이었다. 8명의 환자를 대상으로 한 장기 추적 관찰 결과, 병변 용적 감소는 중앙값 47.0% (IQR, 17.5%-73.2%; P = .016)였으며, 추적 기간 중앙값은 299일 (IQR, 256-739일)이었다. 9명의 환자 중 6명이 추적 기간 동안 증상 호전을 보고했으며, 주요 합병증은 없었으나, 3명의 환자에서 무증상 간주변 혈종(Perihepatic Hematomas)이 발생했고, 1명의 환자는 늑간 신경통(Intercostal Neuralgia)으로 인해 장기간 진통제 치료가 필요했다.
summary.implication: 블레오마이신 전기경화술(BEST)은 수술이 불가능한 거대 간혈종 환자의 치료에 대한 안전하고 효과적인 옵션이 될 수 있으며, 추가적인 무작위 대조 연구(RCT)를 통해 그 효과를 입증할 필요가 있다.

title: Unexpected Near-Complete Hepatocellular Carcinoma Necrosis After Blind Gelatin Embolization of a Liver Biopsy Tract.
Synchronous Percutaneous Biopsy and Cryoablation for Suspicious Solitary Pulmonary Nodules.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the feasibility, diagnostic yield, and safety of synchronous CT-guided core needle biopsy and cryoablation for highly suspicious 1-2 cm pulmonary nodules MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 102 consecutive patients undergoing synchronous CT-guided core needle biopsy and cryoablation between August 2020 and October 2025. Treatment was undertaken on the basis of clinical and imaging suspicion before final histopathologic diagnosis. A cryoprobe was placed before biopsy to provide an intraprocedural landmark. Technical success, diagnostic yield, and adverse events were evaluated in all 102 patients; local tumor progression and overall survival were evaluated separately in 81 patients with pathology-confirmed NSCLC. RESULTS: Cryoablation technical success was 100% (102/102), and concurrent biopsy diagnostic yield was 87.3% (89/102). Biopsy identified 86 malignant diagnoses, including 81 NSCLCs. Mean nodule diameter was 1.52 ± 0.30 cm. Median follow-up in the NSCLC cohort was 34.5 months (IQR, 18.4-49.4 months). The cumulative incidence of recorded local tumor progression was 8.8% at both 1 and 3 years, and overall survival was 100% and 90.8%, respectively. Pneumothorax requiring chest tube drainage occurred in 20.6% (21/102), and no procedure-related deaths were reported. CONCLUSION: The synchronous biopsy and cryoablation approach was technically feasible and provided a specific histopathologic diagnosis in 87.3% of selected patients with highly suspicious 1.0-2.0-cm pulmonary nodules. Among patients with pathology-confirmed NSCLC, local-control outcomes were within the range reported in similar cryoablation-only series.

summary.title_ko: 의심스러운 고립성 폐결절에 대한 동시 CT-가이드 코어 침생검 및 동결 치료의 타당성, 진단 수율 및 안전성 평가
summary.one_line: 이 연구는 고도로 의심스러운 1~2cm 폐결절 환자에게 동시 CT-가이드 코어 침생검 및 동결 치료를 시행했을 때의 타당성, 진단 수율, 안전성을 평가한 결과, 기술적으로 타당하며 높은 진단 수율을 보였고, 비소세포폐암(NSCLC) 환자에서 국소 종양 진행 관리에 효과적임을 확인했습니다.
summary.design: 후향적 단일 센터 연구 (Retrospective single-center study)
summary.subjects: 대상: 2020년 8월부터 2025년 10월까지 동시 CT-가이드 코어 침생검 및 동결 치료를 받은 환자 102명 (N=102). NSCLC 조직 검사 결과 확인 환자 81명.
summary.intervention: 시술: CT-가이드 코어 침생검(CT-guided core needle biopsy) 후 동결 치료(cryoablation). 동결 치료 전 프로브를 삽입하여 시술 중 지표로 활용.
summary.results:
주요 결과:
* 동결 치료 기술적 성공률: 100% (102/102)
* 동시 침생검 진단 수율: 87.3% (89/102)
* 침생검을 통해 확인된 악성 진단 86건, 이 중 비소세포폐암(NSCLC) 81건
* 평균 결절 직경: 1.52 ± 0.30 cm
* NSCLC 환자군 중간 경과 관찰 기간: 34.5개월 (IQR, 18.4-49.4개월)
* 국소 종양 진행 누적 발생률: 1년 및 3년 시점 모두 8.8%
* 전체 생존율: 1년 100%, 3년 90.8%
* 기흉(pneumothorax) 발생률: 20.6% (21/102), 흉관 배액 필요
* 시술 관련 사망: 없음
summary.implication: 고도로 의심스러운 1.0-2.0cm 폐결절 환자에게 동시 침생검 및 동결 치료는 기술적으로 타당하며, 조직 진단에 유용하다. 비소세포폐암(NSCLC) 환자에서 동결 치료만 시행하는 경우와 유사한 국소 조절 결과를 나타냈다.

title: Celiac Plexus Neurolysis Combined with Intratumoral Injection Improves Pain Control Compared with Neurolysis Alone in Patients with Cancer-Related Upper Abdominal Pain Due to Celiac Plexus Invasion: A Retrospective Study.
Selective Embolization for Recalcitrant Plastic Bronchitis Secondary to a Hepatopulmonary Lymphatic Channel While on VA-ECMO.
Multi-Institutional Review of Inferior Vena Cava Filter Use in Pediatric Patients.
abstract: PURPOSE: Children at risk for pulmonary embolism (PE) may be treated with inferior vena cava (IVC) filter insertion when anticoagulation is impossible or ineffective. The purpose of this multi-institutional retrospective review is to better understand the indications and technical and clinical outcomes related to IVC filter placement and removal in pediatric patients. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This study was open to all institutions that placed IVC filters in pediatric patients. Data collected included demographics, indications, procedural details of filter insertion and/or removal, and clinical follow-up. Univariate analysis was performed. RESULTS: A total of 250 filters were placed in 242 pediatric patients (135 male) at 12 participating hospitals between October 1994 and June 2020. Thrombosis was present in 82.8% of patients, PE in 34.8%, and anticoagulation adverse events (AEs) or contraindications in 45.9%. Most filter insertions were technically successful (99.1%); 3.1% were associated with minor AEs, and 0.4% with moderate AEs. Breakthrough pulmonary embolism occurred in 1.4% following filter placement. Filter retrieval rate was 76%. Removal was technically successful in 88% of attempts and resulted in minor AEs in 1.1% and severe AEs in 6.5%. Minor, moderate, and severe device-associated AEs occurred in 8%, 1.6%, and 3.2% of filters, respectively. There was no correlation between age or weight and outcomes, including breakthrough PE, AEs, or mortality. CONCLUSION: IVC filter insertion in pediatric patients is feasible and associated with a high retrieval rate.

summary.title_ko: 소아 환자 하대정맥(Inferior Vena Cava) 필터 삽입 사용에 대한 다기관 검토
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 1994년 10월부터 2020년 6월까지 12개 병원에서 시행된 소아 환자의 하대정맥 필터 삽입 및 제거에 대한 후향적 다기관 연구로, 시술 성공률, 합병증 발생률, 제거 성공률 등을 평가하여 안전성과 유용성을 확인하였다.
summary.subjects: 총 242명의 소아 환자 (남아 135명), 250개의 하대정맥 필터 (IVC filter)
summary.intervention: 하대정맥 필터(IVC filter) 삽입 및 제거 (간동맥화학색전술(TACE)은 관련 없음)
summary.results: 총 250개의 하대정맥 필터가 삽입되었으며, 혈전증(Thrombosis) 환자는 82.8%, 폐색전증(Pulmonary Embolism, PE) 환자는 34.8%, 항응고제(Anticoagulation) 부작용(Adverse Events, AEs) 또는 금기증(Contraindications) 환자는 45.9%였다. 필터 삽입은 99.1%의 높은 기술적 성공률을 보였으며, 경미한 부작용(Minor AEs)은 3.1%, 중등한 부작용(Moderate AEs)은 0.4%에서 발생했다. 필터 삽입 후 폐색전증 발생률은 1.4%였다. 하대정맥 필터 제거 시술 성공률은 76%였으며, 제거 시술 성공률은 88%였다. 제거 시술 후 경미한 부작용은 1.1%, 중증 부작용(Severe AEs)은 6.5%에서 발생했다. 장치 관련 부작용(Device-associated AEs)은 경미, 중등, 중증에서 각각 8%, 1.6%, 3.2% 발생했다. 나이 또는 체중과 결과(폐색전증 발생, 부작용, 사망) 사이에는 상관관계가 없었다.
summary.implication: 소아 환자에게 하대정맥 필터 삽입은 기술적으로 가능하며 높은 제거율을 보이며, 항응고제 사용이 불가능하거나 효과적이지 않은 환자에게 효과적인 치료 옵션이 될 수 있다. 하지만 잠재적인 부작용 발생 가능성을 고려하여 신중하게 사용해야 한다.

title: Single-Session Ablative Radioembolization for Small Hepatocellular Carcinoma Is Associated with Lower Treatment-Episode Charges, Shorter Time to Treatment, and Reduced Travel Burden.
abstract: PURPOSE: To test the hypothesis that, compared with conventional two-session transarterial radioembolization (TARE), single-session TARE (ssTARE) is associated with lower hospital charges, fewer modeled interventional radiology (IR) physician work relative value units (wRVUs), shorter consultation-to-treatment intervals, and less procedure-related travel in selected patients undergoing ablative TARE for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This single-institution retrospective review included 312 treatment episodes in 255 patients between January 2022 and April 2026, comprising 96 single-session ablative TARE episodes and 216 conventional TARE episodes. Conventional TARE was defined as mapping angiography with Tc-99m MAA administration, SPECT/CT, and lung shunt fraction calculation followed by Y-90 administration during a separate encounter. RESULTS: Ninety-three of 96 ssTARE attempts (96.9%) had successful Y-90 delivery. All treatments used glass microspheres. Mean recorded hospital charges were $118,656 for conventional TARE (n=202) and $86,193 for ssTARE (n=51), a 27.4% reduction (p < 0.001). Lower charges persisted in sensitivity analyses. ssTARE was associated with 17.9% fewer modeled IR physician wRVUs and 42.6% fewer modeled driving miles (p < 0.01). The primary consultation-to-treatment interval was 15 days shorter (p < 0.01). CONCLUSION: In selected patients with HCC, ssTARE was associated with lower recorded institutional charges, fewer modeled procedure-related travel miles, and a shorter consultation-to-treatment interval.

summary.title_ko: 소형 간세포암 환자의 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술(Radioembolization)은 치료 관련 비용 감소, 치료 기간 단축, 이동 거리 감소와 관련이 있다
summary.one_line: 소형 간세포암 환자에게 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술(ssTARE)은 기존의 2회 세션 방사성 혈관색전술(TARE)에 비해 비용, 시술 시간, 이동 거리 측면에서 이점을 제공한다.
summary.subjects: 255명의 환자, 총 312건의 치료 에피소드 (단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술 96건, 기존 방사성 혈관색전술 216건)
summary.intervention: 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술 (ssTARE) vs. 기존 2회 세션 방사성 혈관색전술 (TARE). 기존 TARE는 Tc-99m MAA 투여를 통한 혈관 지도 촬영, SPECT/CT, 폐류 우회율 계산 후 별도의 시술에서 Y-90 투여로 정의됨.
summary.results: 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술(ssTARE)군은 기존 방사성 혈관색전술(TARE)군에 비해 평균 병원 비용이 27.4% 감소 (p < 0.001). 구체적으로, ssTARE군은 $86,193 (n=51)이고, TARE군은 $118,656 (n=202)임. 또한, 모델링된 방사선 중재 전문의(IR) 작업 상대 가치 단위(wRVUs)가 17.9% 감소 (p < 0.01), 시술 관련 주행 거리가 42.6% 감소 (p < 0.01), 상담부터 치료까지의 기간이 15일 단축 (p < 0.01)됨. 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술 시술 성공률은 96.9% (93/96)로 높음.
summary.implication: 선택된 간세포암 환자에게 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술은 기존의 2회 세션 방사성 혈관색전술에 비해 비용 효율적이며 환자의 불편함을 줄일 수 있다.
summary.detailed_results: 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술(ssTARE)군은 기존 방사성 혈관색전술(TARE)군에 비해 병원 비용이 유의미하게 낮았으며, 민감도 분석에서도 동일한 결과가 나타남. 모든 치료는 유리 마이크로 구체(glass microspheres)를 사용함.  상담-치료 기간 단축 효과는 15일이었으며, 이는 통계적으로 유의미함 (p < 0.01).
summary.critique: 본 연구는 단일 기관에서 후향적으로 진행되었으며, 따라서 결과의 일반화에는 제한이 있을 수 있다. 또한, 모델링된 IR physician wRVUs 및 주행 거리는 실제 비용과 정확히 일치하지 않을 수 있다.  추적 기간 및 장기적인 치료 효과에 대한 정보는 제공되지 않았다.
summary.clinical_application: 간세포암 환자, 특히 소형 종양을 가진 환자에게 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술을 고려할 때, 비용 절감 및 환자 편의성 향상에 대한 잠재적 이점을 평가해야 한다.  향후 전향적 연구를 통해 단일 세션 방사성 혈관색전술의 효과와 안전성을 더 명확하게 입증할 필요가 있다.

title: Efficacy of Radiofrequency Combined with Chemical Sympatholysis in the Treatment of Primary Palmar Hyperhidrosis: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
abstract: PURPOSE: To investigate and compare the efficacy and safety of radiofrequency thermocoagulation (RFT) and combined with chemical sympatholysis (RFT-CS) for the treatment of primary palmar hyperhidrosis (PPH) (Hyperhidrosis Disease Severity Scale [HDSS] grade III or IV). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Patients who underwent computed tomography-guided percutaneous thoracic sympathetic neurolysis (TSN) for PPH were retrospectively analyzed and divided into two treatment regimens: RFT (group RFT, N = 60, 120 sides) and RFT combined with CS (group RFT-CS, N = 58, 116 sides). RESULTS: At 1, 3, 6, 12, and 24 months, the number of sides with HDSS III/IV in the RFT group was 29, 32, 41, 47, and 56, respectively; in the RFT-CS group, 25, 31, 36, 40, and 45, with no statistically significant intergroup differences at any time point (all P ≥ .05). Overall recurrence rates rose from 3.0% at 1 month to 19.5% at 24 months, with no significant differences between groups at any time point (all P ≥ .05). The RFT-CS group had significantly higher compensatory hyperhidrosis (CH) rates at 12 months (62.1% vs. 56.7%; P = .012) and 24 months (58.6% vs. 50.0%; P = .014), and a higher incidence of thoracic neuralgia at 1 month (P = .023) and 3 months (P = .011). CONCLUSION: Both of the TSN treatment modes are effective for the treatment of severe PPH. Compared with RFT alone, RFT combined with CS does not seem to show better efficacy but increases the occurrence of CH and thoracic neuralgia.

summary.title_ko: 원치 않는 손바닥 다한증 치료에 방사파 열응고술과 화학적 교감신경 차단 병행 효과: 후향적 코호트 연구
summary.one_line: 원치 않는 손바닥 다한증 환자에서 방사파 열응고술(RFT)과 화학적 교감신경 차단(CS) 병행은 단독 방사파 열응고술에 비해 유효성 면에서 우위를 보이지 않으며, 보상성 다한증(CH) 및 흉통 신경통 발생률을 높일 수 있다.
summary.subjects: 원치 않는 손바닥 다한증 환자 (HDSS III/IV 등급) 총 118명 (방사파 열응고술군(RFT): 60명, 120측; 방사파 열응고술-화학적 교감신경 차단군(RFT-CS): 58명, 116측)
summary.intervention: 방사파 열응고술(RFT) 단독 또는 방사파 열응고술(RFT)과 화학적 교감신경 차단(CS) 병행.  모든 환자는 컴퓨터 단층 촬영(computed tomography)-가이드 경피 흉부 교감신경 차단술(TSN) 시행.
summary.results: 1, 3, 6, 12, 24개월 시점에서 HDSS III/IV 등급인 측의 수는 방사파 열응고술군(RFT)은 각각 29, 32, 41, 47, 56이었고, 방사파 열응고술-화학적 교감신경 차단군(RFT-CS)은 각각 25, 31, 36, 40, 45로, 모든 시점에서 통계적으로 유의한 차이가 없었음 (모두 P ≥ .05). 전체 재발률은 1개월 시점 3.0%에서 24개월 시점 19.5%로 증가했으며, 두 군 간에 통계적으로 유의한 차이가 없었음 (모두 P ≥ .05). 방사파 열응고술-화학적 교감신경 차단군(RFT-CS)은 12개월 시점(62.1% vs. 56.7%; P = .012) 및 24개월 시점(58.6% vs. 50.0%; P = .014)에서 보상성 다한증(CH) 발생률이 유의하게 높았으며, 1개월(P = .023) 및 3개월(P = .011) 시점에서 흉통 신경통 발생률도 높았다.
summary.implication: 원치 않는 손바닥 다한증 치료에 있어 방사파 열응고술(RFT) 단독 또는 방사파 열응고술(RFT)과 화학적 교감신경 차단(CS) 병행 모두 효과적이지만, 방사파 열응고술(RFT)과 화학적 교감신경 차단(CS) 병행은 보상성 다한증(CH) 및 흉통 신경통 발생 위험을 증가시킬 수 있으므로 신중하게 고려해야 한다.

title: Intra-Articular Injection Use and Total Knee Arthroplasty After Genicular Artery Embolization for Knee Osteoarthritis: A Matched National Claims Analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: To characterize intra-articular injection use before and after genicular artery embolization (GAE) for knee osteoarthritis (OA) and to compare progression to total knee arthroplasty (TKA) with matched knee OA patients. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort study used the Merative MarketScan Commercial and Medicare Supplemental databases, 2014-2024. Patients undergoing GAE for knee OA were identified by CPT code 37242 with a knee OA diagnosis within 7 days, excluding non-OA indications. Annualized steroid and any intra-articular injection use was compared for the 12 months before and 6 months after GAE. Progression to TKA at 6 and 12 months was analyzed against non-GAE knee OA patients matched 10:1 on age, sex, region, index year, and baseline injection frequency. RESULTS: Of 436 patients with GAE for knee OA, 126 met enrollment criteria for the injection analysis (mean age, 64.2 years; 57.9% female). Mean annualized steroid injection use decreased from 0.96 to 0.48 per patient-year (-50.4%; P = .004) and any intra-articular injection from 2.88 to 1.60 (-44.4%; P < .001). Among 52 baseline steroid injection users, 36 (69.2%) stopped and 46 (88.5%) had fewer injections. TKA did not differ from matched comparators at 6 months (5.8% vs 6.8%; P = .858) or 12 months (13.1% vs 12.8%; P = 1.000). CONCLUSION: Steroid injection use decreased after GAE, while early progression to TKA did not differ from matched comparators. Prospective studies with longer follow-up and clinical outcomes are needed to determine whether GAE reduces the need for injections or affects long-term TKA rates.

summary.title_ko: 무릎 골관절염 환자의 슬개동맥화학색전술(Genicular Artery Embolization, GAE) 시행 후 관절내 주사 사용량 변화 및 전절제술(Total Knee Arthroplasty, TKA) 진행률 비교: 전국 보험 청구 데이터 분석
summary.one_line: 슬개동맥화학색전술(GAE) 시행 후 무릎 골관절염 환자의 관절내 스테로이드 주사 사용량이 감소했지만, 전절제술(TKA) 진행률은 대조군과 차이가 없었다.
summary.subjects: GAE 시행 환자 436명 중 126명 (평균 연령 64.2세, 여성 57.9%) 및 대조군 1260명
summary.intervention: 슬개동맥화학색전술(Genicular Artery Embolization, GAE) (CPT 코드 37242)
summary.results: GAE 시행 전 12개월 동안 환자 1인당 연간 스테로이드 주사 사용량은 0.96회에서 0.48회로 감소 (-50.4%, P = .004), 모든 관절내 주사 사용량은 2.88회에서 1.60회로 감소 (-44.4%, P < .001). 스테로이드 주사 사용자 52명 중 36명 (69.2%)이 주사를 중단하고 46명 (88.5%)이 주사 횟수가 줄었다. GAE 시행 6개월 후 (5.8% vs 6.8%, P = .858) 및 12개월 후 (13.1% vs 12.8%, P = 1.000) 전절제술(TKA) 진행률은 대조군과 차이가 없었다.
summary.implication: 슬개동맥화학색전술(GAE)은 관절내 주사 사용량을 감소시킬 수 있지만, 전절제술(TKA) 진행률에 미치는 영향은 불확실하다. 장기간 추적 관찰과 임상 결과 평가를 포함한 전향적 연구가 필요하다.

title: Unusual Medial Course of Profunda Femoris Artery Complicating Femoral Venous Access.
Automated Detection of Endoleaks in CT Angiography Using a Single Deep Learning Model.
abstract: AIM: Detecting endoleaks on post-EVAR CT scans, especially in the presence of artifacts caused by embolic agents like Onyx, is a challenging but critical task. In this study, we propose a deep learning-based method for endoleak detection using a single object detection model. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective dataset comprising 249 CT scans was used, divided into training (129 scans) and test (120 scans) datasets. Ground truth annotations were obtained through 3D manual segmentation, and a preprocessing pipeline was applied. The model was trained on slices extracted from the training dataset and validated using standard metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, and AUC. RESULTS: The model achieved high performance at both the per-slice and per-series levels. Per-slice detection yielded a ROC AUC of 96%, with a sensitivity of 91%, specificity of 93%, PPV of 55%, and NPV of 99%. At the per-series level, sensitivity and specificity were 93% and 95%, respectively. Notably, our method introduces a per-slice detection metric, which was not reported in previous studies, and uses a single model, making it computationally efficient and easy to train. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates the feasibility of using deep learning for endoleak detection, offering a robust and efficient tool for clinical practice. Future work could focus on expanding the dataset and integrating additional predictive capabilities, such as endoleak classification and localization.

summary.title_ko: 단일 딥러닝 모델을 이용한 CT 혈관조영술에서의 내출혈 자동 감지

title: Percutaneous Deep Venous Arterialization Using the Boomerang® Catheter System.
Ex Vivo Histopathological Validation of Optical Frequency Domain Imaging for Diagnosing Intimal and Medial Calcification in a Single Femoropopliteal Lesion.
abstract: Optical frequency domain imaging (OFDI) is available to guide atherectomy for severely calcified femoropopliteal lesions in patients with lower extremity artery disease, although its diagnostic accuracy has not been histologically validated. We evaluated the diagnostic capability of OFDI through histopathological co-registration. A total of 38 OFDI cross-sectional images from a single vessel in one patient were successfully co-registered with corresponding histological sections and analyzed. The internal elastic lamina was not identified in 52.6% of images. OFDI detected 60.2% of all calcifications identified histologically, with substantially higher detection rates for intimal than medial calcification (72.3% vs 30.8%). These findings indicate that OFDI provides acceptable assessment of intimal calcification but has limited capability for visualizing the medial layer in severely calcified femoropopliteal lesions. Recognition of these limitations may facilitate more appropriate pre-procedural planning for atherectomy in patients with severely calcified femoropopliteal disease.

summary.title_ko: 광주파도메인영상(OFDI)을 이용한 단일 대퇴-경골부위 병변 내막 및 중막 석회화 진단의 조직병리학적 검증
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 광주파도메인영상(OFDI)이 심하게 석회화된 대퇴-경골부위 병변의 내막 석회화를 평가하는데 적절하지만 중막 석회화 시각화 능력은 제한적임을 조직병리학적으로 검증하였다.
summary.subjects: 1명의 환자, 단일 혈관에서 38개의 광주파도메인영상(OFDI) 단면 이미지
summary.intervention: 광주파도메인영상(OFDI)을 이용한 석회화 평가 후 조직병리학적 검증 (Histopathological Co-registration)
summary.results: 총 38개의 광주파도메인영상(OFDI) 이미지가 조직학적 단면에 성공적으로 등록되어 분석되었으며, 내탄성막(internal elastic lamina)은 52.6%의 이미지에서 식별되지 않았다. 광주파도메인영상(OFDI)은 조직학적으로 확인된 전체 석회화의 60.2%를 감지했으며, 내막 석회화 감지율이 중막 석회화 감지율보다 훨씬 높았다 (72.3% vs 30.8%).
summary.implication: 광주파도메인영상(OFDI)은 심하게 석회화된 대퇴-경골부위 병변의 내막 석회화 평가에 유용하지만, 중막 석회화 시각화 능력의 한계를 인지하고 이에 따라 동맥류 제거술(atherectomy) 전 계획을 수립해야 한다.

title: Balloon-occluded pulmonary arteriography and n-butyl cyanoacrylate embolization of angiographically occult pulmonary artery pseudoaneurysms.
abstract: Angiographically occult pulmonary artery pseudoaneurysms - suspected on computed tomography but not shown at selective pulmonary angiography - have been presumed to have an occluded parent artery, and systemic-feeder embolization alone is often not curative. Three consecutive men with infection-related pseudoaneurysms presenting with massive hemoptysis were treated. In each, selective pulmonary angiography without occlusion showed proximal washout of injected contrast, consistent with reversed flow in the parent branch. The branch was occluded immediately proximal to the sac with a 4.0-mm microballoon - or, initially in one patient, a fortuitously wedged 5-F catheter - and hand injection under occlusion opacified the previously occult sac, which was then embolized with 25% n-butyl cyanoacrylate through a microballoon, without same-session systemic-artery embolization. All three achieved technical and clinical success, without recurrent hemoptysis over 17-22 months. Occultness does not equate to an occluded parent artery.

summary.title_ko: 컴퓨터 단층 촬영(CT)으로 의심되었으나 혈관조영술에서 보이지 않는 폐동맥 가성동맥에 대한 풍선 폐색(Balloon-occluded pulmonary arteriography) 및 n-부틸 시아노아크릴레이트(n-butyl cyanoacrylate) 색전술
summary.one_line: 컴퓨터 단층 촬영(CT)에서 의심되었으나 혈관조영술에서 보이지 않는 폐동맥 가성동맥의 경우, 풍선 폐색을 통해 잠재 동맥을 확인하고 n-부틸 시아노아크릴레이트(n-butyl cyanoacrylate) 색전술을 시행하여 치료 효과를 얻을 수 있다.
summary.subjects: 3명의 남성 환자 (infection-related 가성동맥으로 인한 출혈)
summary.intervention: 선택적 폐동맥 혈관조영술(selective pulmonary angiography) 시행 후, 4.0mm 풍선(microballoon) 또는 5-F 카테터를 사용하여 잠재 동맥을 폐색하고, n-부틸 시아노아크릴레이트(n-butyl cyanoacrylate) 25%를 색전 물질로 주입. 동시의 전신 동맥 색전술(systemic-artery embolization)은 시행하지 않음.
summary.results: 3명의 환자 모두 기술적 성공(technical success) 및 임상적 성공(clinical success)을 거두었으며, 17-22개월 동안 재출혈(recurrent hemoptysis)이 발생하지 않았다. 혈관조영술에서 보이지 않는 가성동맥은 잠재 동맥이 막혀 있는 것이 아닐 수 있다.
summary.implication: 컴퓨터 단층 촬영(CT)에서 의심되었으나 혈관조영술에서 보이지 않는 폐동맥 가성동맥의 경우, 풍선 폐색(balloon occlusion)을 통해 잠재 동맥을 확인하고 색전술을 시행하는 것이 효과적인 치료 방법이 될 수 있으며, 잠재 동맥이 막혀있다고 단정 지을 수 없다.

title: In Vitro Development and Evaluation of an Endovascular Islet Cell Stent for Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus.
abstract: PURPOSE: To describe the in vitro development and benchtop evaluation of the IsletStent, an endovascular biologic stent-graft incorporating expanded polytetrafluoroethylene (ePTFE) semipermeable membranes, designed for portal venous delivery of pancreatic islets as a treatment for type 1 diabetes mellitus. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Prototypes with a 0.22 μm pore ePTFE membrane were seeded with murine (approximately 5,000-6,000 islet equivalents [IEQ]) or human (approximately 10,000 IEQ) islets. A benchtop normothermic perfusion circuit simulated intravascular deployment. Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion (GSIS) was assessed in a repeated-measures design (n = 4 devices per experiment); murine islet-seeded devices were perfused under zero (0 mM), low (2.8 mM), and high (28 mM) glucose, and human islet-seeded devices under low and high glucose only, with insulin quantified by ELISA. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modeling under idealized, non-physiologic single-fluid conditions evaluated candidate device geometries. RESULTS: Murine islet-seeded devices demonstrated glucose-responsive insulin secretion: 3-hour insulin concentrations were 83 ± 8 vs. 145 ± 20 μIU/mL under low vs. high glucose (p = 0.02), and secretion rates were 5,344 ± 144 vs. 6,795 ± 503 μIU/hr (p = 0.008). Human islet-seeded devices responded concordantly, with 3-hour insulin concentrations of 229 ± 13 vs. 300 ± 17 μIU/mL (p = 0.014). CONCLUSION: In this benchtop perfusion model, islets housed within an ePTFE-based endovascular stent-graft retained glucose-responsive insulin secretion. In vivo evaluation of islet viability, direct immunoisolation, hemodynamic impact, and long-term function is required before clinical translation.

summary.title_ko: 1형 당뇨병 치료를 위한 혈관내 이식 세포 스텐트 개발 및 평가: 시험관 내 연구
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 1형 당뇨병 치료를 위해 설계된 혈관내 생체 스텐트-이식(IsletStent)의 시험관 내 개발 및 성능 평가를 통해 포털 정맥을 통한 췌장 이식 세포 전달 가능성을 확인하였다.
summary.subjects: 실험실 환경에서 제작된 스텐트 장치 (n=4 devices per experiment)
summary.intervention: 확장 폴리테트라플루오로에틸렌(ePTFE) 반투과막을 통합한 혈관내 생체 스텐트-이식(IsletStent)에 마우스(5,000-6,000 이식 세포 당량 [IEQ]) 또는 인간(10,000 IEQ) 췌장 이식 세포를 접종.
summary.results: 마우스 이식 세포 접종 스텐트 장치는 포도당 자극 인슐린 분비(GSIS)를 나타냈으며, 3시간 인슐린 농도는 낮은 포도당(0 mM) 조건에서 83 ± 8 μIU/mL, 높은 포도당(28 mM) 조건에서 145 ± 20 μIU/mL (p = 0.02), 분비율은 5,344 ± 144 μIU/hr vs. 6,795 ± 503 μIU/hr (p = 0.008)로 나타났다. 인간 이식 세포 접종 스텐트 장치 역시 유사한 반응을 보였으며, 3시간 인슐린 농도는 낮은 포도당 조건에서 229 ± 13 μIU/mL, 높은 포도당 조건에서 300 ± 17 μIU/mL (p = 0.014)로 나타났다.
summary.implication: 본 연구는 시험관 내 환경에서 ePTFE 기반 혈관내 스텐트-이식 장치 내 이식 세포가 포도당 반응성 인슐린 분비를 유지함을 보여주었지만, 생체 내(in vivo) 평가를 통해 이식 세포 생존력, 면역 격리 효과, 혈역학적 영향, 장기적인 기능 등을 확인해야 임상 적용 가능성을 판단할 수 있다.

title: Patient-Defined Experience in Venous-Origin Chronic Pelvic Pain: Conceptual Foundation for a Disease-Specific Patient-Reported Outcome Measure.
abstract: PURPOSE: To characterize the symptoms, daily life impacts, and patient-defined meaningful treatment benefits of women with venous-origin chronic pelvic pain (VO-CPP), and to establish the conceptual basis for a disease-specific patient-reported outcome measure (PROM). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Twenty-one adult women with gynecologic pain specialist-confirmed VO-CPP underwent semi-structured concept elicitation interviews at seven U.S. CENTERS: Interviews explored symptoms, daily life impacts, and patient-defined meaningful treatment benefits. Transcripts were analyzed using thematic analysis to develop a patient-centered conceptual model. RESULTS: No new impact concepts emerged after five interviews and no new symptom concepts after sixteen; five additional interviews confirmed saturation of symptom and impact concepts. Participants reported a broad symptom burden, with 76% describing ≥10 symptoms, and all reported impacts across at least three daily life domains. Although pelvic pain reduction was the most frequently identified meaningful treatment benefit, participants consistently defined meaningful improvement as restoration of daily functioning and valued activities rather than pain reduction alone. CONCLUSION: Women with VO-CPP experience a multidimensional disease burden extending well beyond pain intensity alone. Treatment outcomes assessment should incorporate patient-defined symptoms, daily life impacts, and meaningful benefits. These findings provide a patient-centered conceptual foundation for development of a VO-CPP PROM.

summary.title_ko: 정맥 기원 만성 골반 통증 환자의 경험 정의: 질병 특이 환자 보고 결과 측정 도구의 개념적 기반
summary.one_line: 정맥 기원 만성 골반 통증(VO-CPP) 환자의 경험을 분석하여 질병 특이 환자 보고 결과 측정 도구(PROM) 개발을 위한 개념적 기반을 마련하고, 환자의 삶에 미치는 다차원적인 영향을 확인했습니다.
summary.subjects: 미국 7개 CENTERS의 성인 여성 환자 21명 (VO-CPP 진단)
summary.intervention: 반구조화된 개념 도출 인터뷰 (증상, 일상생활 영향, 치료 효과)
summary.results: 환자들은 광범위한 증상 부담을 호소했으며, 76%가 10가지 이상의 증상을 경험했고, 모든 환자가 최소 3가지의 일상생활 영역에서 영향을 받았습니다.  가장 흔하게 언급된 치료 효과는 골반 통증 감소였지만, 환자들은 일상 기능 회복 및 가치 있는 활동을 중요하게 생각했으며, 통증 감소 자체보다는 기능 회복을 더 중요하게 정의했습니다. 인터뷰 5개 시점에서 새로운 영향 개념이 더 이상 나타나지 않았고, 16개 시점에서 새로운 증상 개념이 더 이상 나타나지 않아 포화 상태를 확인했습니다.
summary.implication: VO-CPP 환자의 치료 결과 평가는 환자가 정의하는 증상, 일상생활 영향, 그리고 의미 있는 치료 효과를 포함해야 합니다. 본 연구는 VO-CPP PROM 개발을 위한 환자 중심의 개념적 기반을 제공합니다.

title: Quantifying the Role of Interventional Radiology in Managing Patients with Hepatobiliary Cancers.
abstract: PURPOSE: To quantify the role of interventional radiology (IR) in managing primary and secondary hepatobiliary cancers. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed administrative data from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) using final action claims for Medicare Fee-for-Service beneficiaries from 2016 to 2021. Patients aged ≥65 years with hepatobiliary cancer were identified using International Classification of Diseases (ICD), 10th Revision, codes. Services and associated work Relative Value Units (wRVUs) provided by IR, medical oncology, radiation oncology, and surgical oncology were identified using CMS physician specialty codes. IR procedures were classified as therapeutic or supportive. RESULTS: From 2016 to 2021, the Medicare hepatobiliary cancer cohort included 108,317-111,761 patients annually (mean age, 75 years; male, 53%). Medical oncologists treated 70% of patients, followed by interventional radiologists with 51%, radiation oncologists with 13%, and surgical oncologists with 5%. Physician service volumes and wRVU remained stable, with medical oncologists providing the largest share (69% of services and 13.7% of wRVUs), followed by interventional radiologists (2.9% and 11.7%, respectively), radiation oncologists (1.3% and 4.5%, respectively), and surgical oncologists (0.1% and 2.2%, respectively). Interventional radiologists performed 75,785 therapeutic procedures, primarily for hepatocellular carcinoma (59%). Before pandemic, IR volumes increased 57%, driven by liver ablations (+25%) and supportive services (+63%), whereas transarterial therapies declined slightly (-6%). Despite the drop in volume during the pandemic, IR saw the highest compound annual growth rate (4%) among the specialties analyzed. CONCLUSIONS: IR provides a substantial share of services for patients with hepatobiliary cancers, with rising use of therapeutic and supportive services, delivering similar wRVUs at lower costs, underscoring its growing role in cancer care.

summary.title_ko: 간담도암 환자 관리에서 인터벤션 영상의학의 역할 정량화 연구
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 미국 메디케어(Medicare) 데이터를 분석하여 간담도암 환자 관리에서 인터벤션 영상의학(Interventional Radiology, IR)의 역할과 기여도를 정량적으로 평가하였다.
summary.subjects: 2016년-2021년 미국 메디케어(Medicare) 서비스 수혜자 중 간담도암 환자 108,317-111,761명 (연간, 평균 연령 75세, 남성 53%)
summary.intervention: 인터벤션 영상의학(IR) 시술 (치료적/보조적)
summary.results: 인터벤션 영상의학(IR) 전문의는 환자의 51%를 치료했으며, 의학 종양학 전문의(Medical Oncology)가 70%로 가장 높은 비율을 차지했다. 인터벤션 영상의학(IR) 시술은 총 75,785건으로, 주로 원발성 간세포암종(Hepatocellular Carcinoma, HCC)에 사용되었다 (59%). 팬데믹 이전에는 간절제술(+25%) 및 보조적 시술(+63%) 증가로 인터벤션 영상의학(IR) 시술량이 57% 증가했으며, 경동맥화학색전술(TACE)과 같은 동맥내 치료는 소폭 감소했다 (-6%). 팬데믹 기간 동안 시술량이 감소했음에도 인터벤션 영상의학(IR)은 연평균 성장률(4%)이 가장 높았다.
summary.implication: 인터벤션 영상의학(IR)은 간담도암 환자 관리에서 중요한 역할을 수행하며, 치료적 및 보조적 시술 사용이 증가하고 있다. 또한, 인터벤션 영상의학(IR)은 다른 전문 분야에 비해 유사한 작업 상대 가치 단위(wRVU)를 낮은 비용으로 제공하며, 암 치료에서의 역할이 확대되고 있음을 시사한다.
summary.detailed_results: 의료 종양학 전문의는 전체 서비스의 69%를, 작업 상대 가치 단위(wRVU)의 13.7%를 차지했다. 인터벤션 영상의학(IR) 전문의는 2.9%의 서비스와 11.7%의 작업 상대 가치 단위(wRVU)를 차지했다. 방사선 종양학 전문의는 1.3%의 서비스와 4.5%의 작업 상대 가치 단위(wRVU)를 차지했으며, 외과 종양학 전문의는 0.1%의 서비스와 2.2%의 작업 상대 가치 단위(wRVU)를 차지했다. 팬데믹 이전 인터벤션 영상의학(IR) 시술량 증가의 주요 요인은 간절제술(+25%) 및 보조적 시술(+63%) 증가였다.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 후향적 데이터 분석에 기반하여 수행되었으므로, 인과 관계를 명확히 규명하기에는 한계가 있다. 또한, 메디케어(Medicare) 서비스 수혜자만을 대상으로 하였기 때문에 연구 결과를 일반화하는 데 주의가 필요하다. 기존 연구와 비교했을 때, 본 연구는 인터벤션 영상의학(IR)의 역할에 대한 보다 정량적인 데이터를 제공하며, 팬데믹 상황에서의 변화를 분석했다는 점에서 차별성을 가진다.
summary.clinical_application: 간담도암 환자 관리에서 인터벤션 영상의학(IR)의 활용을 확대하고, 환자 맞춤형 치료 계획 수립 시 인터벤션 영상의학(IR) 전문의와의 협진을 고려해야 한다. 또한, 인터벤션 영상의학(IR) 시술의 효과성과 안전성을 지속적으로 평가하여 치료 지침을 개선해야 한다.

title: Five-Year Survival and Durable Local Control After Image-Guided Thermal Ablation for Stage IA Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate five-year overall survival, cancer-specific survival, local tumor progression-free survival, local recurrence, and durable local control after repeat ablation in patients with Stage IA non-small cell lung cancer treated with image-guided thermal ablation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This HIPAA-compliant, institutional review board-approved retrospective cohort study included 85 patients with Stage IA non-small cell lung cancer treated with image-guided thermal ablation between 2011 and 2018. Patients had a single target tumor: 16 T1a, 45 T1b, and 24 T1c tumors. Outcomes included technical success, five-year overall survival (OS), cancer-specific survival (CSS), local tumor progression-free survival (LTPFS), local recurrence, durable local control (no further local recurrence after repeat ablation during follow-up), and adverse events. Kaplan-Meier analysis estimated survival outcomes. RESULTS: Median follow-up was 55.6 months. Ablation modalities included microwave ablation in 41 patients, cryoablation in 37, and radiofrequency ablation in 7. Technical success was 100%. Grade 2 or higher adverse events within 90 days occurred in 8 patients (9.4%), all pneumothoraces requiring chest tubes. Five-year OS was 68.2%, 77.4%, and 68.2%; CSS was 100%, 87.2%, and 100%; and LTPFS was 100%, 77.8%, and 100% for T1a, T1b, and T1c tumors, respectively. Overall five-year LTPFS was 92.6%. Local recurrence occurred in 8 patients (9.4%). Six underwent repeat ablation without subsequent recurrence, yielding durable local control in 97.6%. CONCLUSION: Image-guided thermal ablation provided favorable five-year survival and high durable local control for Stage IA non-small cell lung cancer, supporting ablation as a repeatable and effective treatment option.

summary.title_ko: 1A기 비소세포폐암에서 영상유도 열치료후 5년 생존율 및 지속적인 국소 조절 결과
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 1A기 비소세포폐암 환자에서 영상유도 열치료를 시행한 후 5년 생존율과 국소 재발 없이 지속적인 국소 조절을 달성할 수 있는지 평가한 결과, 우수한 생존율과 높은 국소 조절률을 확인했습니다.
summary.subjects: 1A기 비소세포폐암 환자 85명 (T1a: 16명, T1b: 45명, T1c: 24명)
summary.intervention: 영상유도 열치료 (Image-Guided Thermal Ablation): 마이크로파 열치료(Microwave Ablation) 41명, 동결치료(Cryoablation) 37명, 고주파 열치료(Radiofrequency Ablation) 7명
summary.results: 중앙 추적 관찰 기간 55.6개월, 기술적 성공률 100%. 5년 전체 생존율(Overall Survival, OS)은 T1a: 68.2%, T1b: 77.4%, T1c: 68.2%, 5년 암종 특이 생존율(Cancer-Specific Survival, CSS)은 T1a: 100%, T1b: 87.2%, T1c: 100%, 5년 국소 종양 진행 없는 생존율(Local Tumor Progression-Free Survival, LTPFS)은 T1a: 100%, T1b: 77.8%, T1c: 100%. 전체 5년 LTPFS는 92.6%. 국소 재발은 8명(9.4%)에서 발생했으며, 재치료를 통해 추가 재발 없이 국소 조절을 달성한 환자는 6명으로, 지속적인 국소 조절률은 97.6%로 나타났습니다. 90일 이내 심각한 부작용(Grade 2 이상)은 8명(9.4%)에서 발생했으며, 모두 기흉(Pneumothorax)으로 흉관 삽입이 필요했습니다.
summary.implication: 영상유도 열치료는 1A기 비소세포폐암 환자에게 우수한 5년 생존율과 높은 지속적인 국소 조절을 제공하며, 반복적인 치료 옵션으로서 효과적입니다.

title: Trends in Retraction of Vascular and Interventional Radiology Research.
abstract: Retractions play an important role in maintaining the integrity of vascular and interventional radiology (VIR) literature, yet their causes and trends remain uncharacterized. A search of PubMed, Embase, and the Retraction Watch Database in April 2026 identified 142 retracted VIR articles published since 2000. The leading reasons for retraction were peer-review manipulation (21.1%), intrinsic study errors (14.8%), and submission duplication (11.3%), although 40% of notices did not specify a reason. Most articles originated from China (69%) and addressed interventional oncology (35.2%). Retractions rose sharply in recent years, with 64.7% occurring between 2023 and 2026. The median time from publication to retraction was 14.8 months, and most articles were retracted within two years. Journal impact factor ranged widely (0.60-78.50) and was not associated with time to retraction. These findings highlight peer-review manipulation as a prominent mechanism of misconduct and reaffirm the importance of rigorous peer review and editorial screening.

summary.title_ko: 혈관중재영상의학(VIR) 연구 논문 철회 추세 분석
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 2000년 이후 발표된 혈관중재영상의학(VIR) 논문들의 철회 원인 및 추세를 분석하여, 동료 평가 조작(peer-review manipulation)이 주요 원인이며 최근 철회 건수가 급증하고 있음을 확인했습니다.
summary.design: 후향적 코호트 연구 (Retraction Watch Database, PubMed, Embase 검색)
summary.subjects: 2000년 이후 발표된 혈관중재영상의학(VIR) 논문 142건 (N=142)
summary.intervention: 해당 없음 (논문 철회 데이터 분석)
summary.results: 철회 원인은 동료 평가 조작(peer-review manipulation) 21.1%, 연구 자체 오류(intrinsic study errors) 14.8%, 논문 중복 제출(submission duplication) 11.3%였으며, 40%는 철회 사유 미기재.  대부분의 논문은 중국(69%)에서 발표되었고, 중재 종양학(interventional oncology) 관련 논문(35.2%)이 많았습니다. 2023년에서 2026년 사이에 철회 건수가 급증했으며(64.7%), 논문 발표 후 철회까지의 중간 시간은 14.8개월, 대부분 2년 이내에 철회되었습니다. 학술지 영향력 지수(journal impact factor)는 0.60-78.50으로 다양했으며, 철회 시간과 관련이 없었습니다.
summary.implication: 본 연구는 동료 평가 조작(peer-review manipulation)이 혈관중재영상의학(VIR) 연구의 주요 문제임을 시사하며, 더욱 엄격한 동료 평가 및 편집 검토의 중요성을 강조합니다.

title: Endovascular Venous Stenting for Chronic Iliofemoral Venous Obstruction in Post-Thrombotic Syndrome and Non-Thrombotic Iliac Vein Lesion: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials and Prospective Single-Arm Clinical Trials.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate pooled patency, symptomatic, and safety outcomes following dedicated nitinol venous stent placement for symptomatic chronic iliofemoral venous obstruction (CIVO), and to compare outcomes between post-thrombotic syndrome (PTS) and non-thrombotic iliac vein lesion (NIVL) etiologies. METHODS: PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched from inception to May 2026 for randomized controlled trials and prospective registered single-arm studies evaluating venous stents in symptomatic CIVO. Proportional meta-analysis was conducted using Stata(v19.5). Risk of bias was judged with RoB-2 and ROBINS-I. Certainty of evidence was evaluated with GRADE. RESULTS: 13 studies (21 arms; n=1450) were included. Pooled 12-month primary patency was 93% (95% CI 90-97; I2=83.17%), declining to 90% and 89% at 24 and 36-months, respectively. Primary patency at 12-months was significantly greater in NIVL (98%; 95% CI 96-99%; I2=59.05%) than PTS (84%; 95% CI 81-87%; I2=0.0%). A mean reduction of 4.76 points in Venous Clinical Severity Score (VCSS) (0-30 scale; higher score indicates greater severity) and 6.40 points in Villalta score (0-33 scale; ≥5 indicates PTS) was observed. Stent thrombosis occurred more frequently in PTS than NIVL. Exploratory analysis of three RCTs demonstrated reduction in VCSS for stent placement versus standard of care (2.24; 95% CI -3.34 to -1.14; I2=0%). CONCLUSION: Prospective evidence suggests favorable patency and symptom improvement following venous stent placement for symptomatic CIVO, although substantial heterogeneity and low-to-very-low certainty of evidence warrant cautious interpretation. Outcomes differ significantly between PTS and NIVL, reflecting an association between etiology and long-term stent performance.

summary.title_ko: 만성 요골-대퇴 동맥 폐쇄에 대한 혈관 스텐트 삽입술: 혈전후 증후군(PTS)과 비혈전성 대퇴 동맥 병변(NIVL) 환자군 비교 체계적 검토 및 메타분석
summary.one_line: 만성 요골-대퇴 동맥 폐쇄 환자에서 혈관 스텐트 삽입술은 우수한 통과율과 증상 개선을 보였으나, 혈전후 증후군(PTS)과 비혈전성 대퇴 동맥 병변(NIVL) 환자군 간 결과에 차이가 있으며, 증거의 질은 낮음.
summary.design: 체계적 검토 및 메타분석 (무작위 배정 임상 시험(RCT) 및 전향적 단일군 임상 시험)
summary.subjects: 총 1450명 (21개 arm; 13개 연구)
summary.intervention: 혈관 스텐트(nitinol venous stent) 삽입술
summary.results: 12개월 1차 통과율(primary patency)은 93% (95% CI 90-97; I2=83.17%)였으며, 24개월과 36개월에 각각 90%와 89%로 감소함. 비혈전성 대퇴 동맥 병변(NIVL) 환자군(98%; 95% CI 96-99%; I2=59.05%)에서 혈전후 증후군(PTS) 환자군(84%; 95% CI 81-87%; I2=0.0%)보다 12개월 1차 통과율이 유의미하게 높았음.  혈관 임상 중증도 점수(VCSS)는 평균 4.76점 감소 (0-30점 척도, 점수가 높을수록 중증), 빌랄타 점수는 평균 6.40점 감소 (0-33점 척도, ≥5는 PTS)함. 혈전증(stent thrombosis)은 PTS 환자군에서 NIVL 환자군보다 더 빈번하게 발생함. 3개의 RCT를 분석한 결과, 스텐트 삽입술은 표준 치료 대비 VCSS 감소(2.24; 95% CI -3.34 to -1.14; I2=0%)를 보임.

title: Treatment Response after Radiofrequency Ablation Alone versus Combined Ethanol Ablation and Radiofrequency Ablation in Predominantly Cystic Thyroid Nodules.
abstract: PURPOSE: To compare longitudinal changes in nodule volume after radiofrequency ablation (RFA) alone versus combined ethanol ablation (EA) and RFA in predominantly cystic thyroid nodules (PCTNs), and to estimate the adjusted treatment effect on achieving a volume reduction rate (VRR) ≥85% at 12 months. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 184 PCTNs in 176 patients treated with RFA alone (81 nodules) or combined EA and RFA (103 nodules). Nodule volume was assessed at baseline and at 3, 6, and 12 months. Longitudinal volume changes were analyzed using an inverse probability of treatment-weighted mixed-effects model, and 12-month VRR ≥85% using multivariable-adjusted and weighted logistic regression. RESULTS: A VRR ≥85% was more frequent after combined treatment at 3, 6, and 12 months (32.0% vs 13.6%, 61.2% vs 40.7%, and 89.3% vs 70.4%, respectively; all P ≤ .006). In the weighted mixed-effects analysis, mean nodule volume was lower with combined treatment at 6 months (difference, -0.81 mL; 95% CI, -1.47 to -0.15; P = .016) and 12 months (difference, -0.86 mL; 95% CI, -1.43 to -0.30; P = .003), whereas the time-by-treatment interaction was not significant (P = .088). Combined treatment was associated with achieving a VRR ≥85% at 12 months in both multivariable analysis (adjusted OR, 4.17; 95% CI, 1.61-11.70; P = .004) and weighted analysis (OR, 2.56; 95% CI, 1.11-5.90; P = .028). CONCLUSION: After confounder adjustment, combined EA and RFA was associated with higher odds of achieving a VRR ≥85% at 12 months than RFA alone.

Adaptation and Initial Psychometric Validation of the Clinician Satisfaction with Sedation Instrument (CSSI) for Interventional Radiology.
abstract: PURPOSE: To adapt and psychometrically validate the Clinician Satisfaction with Sedation Instrument (CSSI) for use in interventional radiology (IR), including assessment of reliability and validity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this prospective observational study, clinician responses were collected following adult IR procedures performed with IR-administered procedural sedation. The original 21-item CSSI was adapted for IR using face validity assessment and pilot testing, resulting in a 13-item instrument. Internal consistency, exploratory factor analysis, inter-rater reliability, criterion validity, construct validity, and convergent validity were evaluated. A secondary cohort assessed physician-physician agreement. RESULTS: One hundred one procedures generated 272 completed surveys from 12 clinicians (10 nurses, 2 physicians). The adapted CSSI demonstrated excellent internal consistency (Cronbach α = 0.968) and a unidimensional factor structure accounting for 73.1% of variance. Inter-rater reliability was moderate between physicians and nurses (ICC = 0.547) and good among nurses (ICC = 0.763). Physician-physician reliability demonstrated good consistency (ICC = 0.688). CSSI scores increased with patient vocalization severity (P < .001), patient movement (P = .041), sedation-related complications (P < .001), multiple procedures (P < .001), and differed across procedure types (P = .030) and sedation regimens (P < .001). CSSI scores also correlated with deepest procedural sedation level (Spearman r = 0.491, P = .028). CONCLUSION: The adapted 13-item CSSI demonstrated excellent internal consistency and initial evidence of reliability and validity for measuring clinician satisfaction with procedural sedation in interventional radiology. The instrument shows potential as a standardized clinician-reported outcome measure for future comparative sedation studies.

title: Emergency Uterine Artery Embolization for Postpartum Hemorrhage: Hemostatic Outcomes According to Embolic Material and Shock Index, with Subsequent Pregnancy Outcomes.
abstract: PURPOSE: To compare hemostatic efficacy and subsequent pregnancy outcomes of gelatin sponge (GS) and n-butyl-2-cyanoacrylate (NBCA) in emergency uterine artery embolization (UAE) for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH), with Shock Index (SI) as an indicator of bleeding severity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed 51 patients who underwent emergency UAE for uncontrolled PPH between January 2012 and December 2024. Hemostatic outcomes were evaluated in all patients. Forty-eight patients with SI data were stratified into three groups: SI <1.0 (n=19), 1.0≤SI<1.5 (n=18), and SI≥1.5 (n=11). Pregnancy outcomes were assessed in 46 patients with uterine preservation and available SI data. RESULTS: Initial embolization used GS in 44 patients (86.3%) and NBCA in 7 (13.7%). The DIC score was higher in the initial NBCA group than in the initial GS group (median, 9 vs. 7; p = 0.017). Initial embolization succeeded in 41 patients (80.4%), including 34/44 (77.3%) with GS and 7/7 (100%) with NBCA (p=0.320). Of 10 initial GS failures, 8 were converted to NBCA and 2 underwent hysterectomy. Final hemostatic success was achieved in 49 patients (96.1%), including all 8 converted cases. Among 46 patients with uterine preservation and available SI data, 9 achieved pregnancy: 6/31 (19.4%) after GS alone and 3/15 (20.0%) after NBCA, including GS-to-NBCA conversion (p=1.000). CONCLUSION: NBCA was effective for hemostasis in emergency UAE for PPH, including after conversion from GS. Subsequent pregnancy rates were comparable between GS alone and NBCA through April 30, 2026.

Impact on renal function, tumor volume, and complications of transarterial embolization for renal angiomyolipomas: An Evidence-Based systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the effect of transarterial embolization (TAE) on tumor burden, renal function, and safety in renal angiomyolipoma (AML), and to identify drivers of between-study heterogeneity. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Systematic review and meta-analysis following PRISMA and prospectively registered in PROSPERO (number on the title page). Major databases were searched through January 2024. Morphologic response was expressed as percentage reduction from baseline (random-effects ratio of means; medians converted by Wan's method); proportions were pooled by arcsine transformation. Risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I, RoB 2, and the JBI checklist. RESULTS: Seventy-nine studies (1,798 patients) were included. TAE reduced tumor volume by 55.7% (95% CI, 49.3-61.3%; I2 = 85.6%; k = 18) and diameter by 34.2% (95% CI, 29.1-38.9%; I2 = 70.1%; k = 43). The interval to post-procedural imaging accounted for 50.7% of the between-study variance in volume reduction (P = .002); predicted reduction rose from 44% at 1 month to 63% at 36 months, a gradient three cohorts with serial imaging reproduced within-study. Serum creatinine and estimated glomerular filtration rate showed no clinically meaningful change from baseline. Pooled technical and clinical success were 98% and 97%; adverse events other than post-embolization syndrome occurred in 3%, and post-embolization syndrome in 46%. CONCLUSIONS: TAE achieves substantial, strongly time-dependent tumor reduction with high procedural success and few adverse events. Renal function was stable relative to baseline, but no included study used a surveillance comparator. Standardized outcome definitions and prespecified imaging intervals are needed before pooled estimates can guide patient selection.

summary.results: 동맥내 색전술(TAE)은 종양 부피를 기준선 대비 55.7% (95% CI, 49.3-61.3%; I2 = 85.6%; k = 18) 감소시키고, 직경을 34.2% (95% CI, 29.1-38.9%; I2 = 70.1%; k = 43) 감소시켰다. 시술 후 영상 검사 간격이 종양 부피 감소의 변동성을 설명하는 요인 중 하나로 작용했으며, 1개월에서 36개월까지 종양 감소율이 44%에서 63%로 증가했다. 혈청 크레아티닌(serum creatinine) 및 추정 사구체 여과율(estimated glomerular filtration rate, eGFR)은 기준선과 비교하여 임상적으로 유의미한 변화를 보이지 않았다. 기술적 성공률은 98%, 임상적 성공률은 97%였으며, 색전술 후 증후군(post-embolization syndrome)을 제외한 부작용 발생률은 3%, 색전술 후 증후군 발생률은 46%였다.

title: Animal Models for Interventional Oncology Research: Overview and Considerations in the Era of New Approach Methodologies.
abstract: While translational animal models play a meaningful role in interventional oncology (IO) research, recent attention has focused on new approach methodologies (NAMs) prioritizing human biology-based paradigms. In this narrative review, animal models used in IO research, spanning mouse, rat, woodchuck, rabbit, pig, dog, and non-human primate platforms, are presented. In addition, "next generation" animal models, such as humanized models, genetically defined models, and comorbidity models, are summarized. Subsequently, NAM concepts, including organoids, organ-on-a-chip systems, ex vivo organ preparations, and artificial intelligence and in silico modeling tools, and their potential for advancing IO research, are described. Finally, the complementary value of preclinical models in the NAMs era and model selection are considered.

title: Yttrium-90 Radioembolization for High-Risk Hepatocellular Adenomas: A Single-Institution Experience.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of Yttrium-90 (Y-90) transarterial radioembolization (TARE) for the treatment of high-risk hepatocellular adenomas (HCAs) at a single tertiary care center. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective review was performed of all patients who underwent TARE for HCAs at a tertiary care center between 2010 and 2025. Clinical, laboratory, imaging, and safety data were collected for twelve patients with 22 HCAs included in the study. The primary endpoint was treatment-related adverse events (AEs) graded by CTCAE and SIR AE classification. The secondary endpoints included target and overall radiologic response assessed by mRECIST.1 Patients were followed up with MRI at 6 weeks, 3 months, 6 months, 9 months, 12 months, 18 months, and 24 months. Median follow-up between Y-90 and latest imaging was 17.7 months, with an IQR of 12.9 [8.0-20.9] months. RESULTS: Indications for treatment included symptomatic adenoma (5%, 1/22), risk of malignant transformation (100%, 22/22) and hemorrhage risk (50%, 11/22). Grade 1 AEs (nausea, fatigue, anorexia, diarrhea, abdominal and shoulder pain) occurred in 75% (9/12) of patients. No grade 2 or greater AEs occurred. The objective response rate (ORR) was 100% (20/20) (complete target lesion response [CR]: 85% (17/20), partial target lesion response [PR]: 15% (3/20)). No lesions ruptured, progressed, or recurred during follow-up. CONCLUSION: In this single-institution experience, TARE was safe and demonstrated high short to intermediate-term ORRs in the treatment of high-risk hepatocellular adenomas. Larger prospective studies with longer duration of follow up are needed to confirm these findings.
