Transarterial Radioembolization for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Beyond the Up-to-Seven Criteria: A Single-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
abstract: PURPOSE: To describe clinical outcomes after transarterial radioembolization (TARE) for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) beyond the Up-to-Seven criteria. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study included 94 treatment-naïve patients with HCC beyond the Up-to-Seven criteria who underwent TARE between November 2021 and December 2025. Outcomes included tumor response, local tumor progression-free survival (LTPFS), progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS), and adverse events. RESULTS: The median maximum tumor diameter was 9.5 cm (interquartile range, 7.1-11.4 cm). A single lesion was observed in 55 (58.5%) patients, 30 (31.9%) had oligonodular disease, and 9 (9.6%) had ≥5 lesions. Index-lesion complete response (CR) and objective response rate (ORR) were 38.3% and 83.0%, respectively; at the patient level, CR and ORR were 38.3% and 81.9%, respectively. Median index-lesion LTPFS, patient-level LTPFS, PFS, and OS were 19.6, 15.7, 11.1, and 30.5 months, respectively. Low tumor-absorbed dose (TAD) was independently associated with worse OS (adjusted hazard ratio, 2.70; p = 0.016). Twenty-one patients (22.3%) subsequently underwent curative-intent surgery after TARE, with a more favorable OS pattern observed in the postsurgery state in an exploratory time-varying analysis (p = 0.004). Three fatal adverse events occurred. CONCLUSION: In this single-center retrospective cohort of patients with HCC beyond the Up-to-Seven criteria, favorable tumor control and survival outcomes were observed after TARE, and 22.3% of patients subsequently underwent curative-intent surgery. Higher TAD was associated with longer OS, although this finding should be interpreted cautiously given the potential for confounding. Careful dosimetric planning is warranted given the observed fatal radiation pneumonitis events.

summary.title_ko: 간세포암종(Hepatocellular Carcinoma, HCC) Up-to-Seven 기준 초과 환자에서의 경동맥방사성입자주입술(Transarterial Radioembolization, TARE)
summary.one_line: Up-to-Seven 기준을 초과하는 간세포암종 환자에서 경동맥방사성입자주입술(TARE) 시행 시, 양호한 종양 조절 및 생존율을 보였으며, 일부 환자는 절제술을 시행할 수 있었다.
summary.subjects: 간세포암종(HCC) 환자 94명 (Up-to-Seven 기준 초과, 치료 경험 없음)
summary.intervention: 경동맥방사성입자주입술(Transarterial Radioembolization, TARE)
summary.results: 종양 반응률(Objective Response Rate, ORR)은 83.0%, 완전 반응(Complete Response, CR)은 38.3%였으며, 환자 수준에서의 ORR은 81.9%, CR은 38.3%였다.  중심 병변(Index-lesion)의 국소 종양 진행 없는 생존 기간(Local Tumor Progression-Free Survival, LTPFS)은 중앙값 19.6개월, 환자 수준의 LTPFS는 15.7개월, 무진행 생존 기간(Progression-Free Survival, PFS)은 11.1개월, 전체 생존 기간(Overall Survival, OS)은 30.5개월이었다.

summary.detailed_results: 환자의 최대 종양 직경 중앙값은 9.5 cm (IQR, 7.1-11.4 cm)였다. 단일 병변은 55명(58.5%), 다발성 병변은 30명(31.9%), 5개 이상의 병변은 9명(9.6%)에서 관찰되었다. 낮은 종양 흡수 선량(Tumor-Absorbed Dose, TAD)은 전체 생존 기간(OS) 악화와 독립적으로 연관되었다 (조정된 위험 비율, adjusted hazard ratio, 2.70; p = 0.016). 21명(22.3%)의 환자가 경동맥방사성입자주입술(TARE) 후 근본적인 치유 의도 절제술을 시행했으며, 시간 변화 분석에서 수술 후 생존율이 더 우수했다 (p = 0.004). 3명의 환자에서 치명적인 부작용이 발생했다 (방사선 폐렴증).

summary.clinical_application: Up-to-Seven 기준을 초과하는 간세포암종(HCC) 환자를 대상으로 경동맥방사성입자주입술(TARE)을 고려할 때, 종양 흡수 선량(TAD)을 최적화하고, 절제술 가능성을 높이기 위한 전략을 수립하며, 방사선 폐렴증과 같은 부작용 발생 가능성에 대한 주의가 필요하다.

title: Wireless Tenzing Crossing of Large Vessel-Occlusions - Feasibility of a Technique After Failed Stroke Thrombectomy with Traditional Approaches.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: To test feasibility of Tenzingplasty as bailout technique for resistant large vessel occlusion (LVO). LVO is primarily treated with endovascular thrombectomy (EVT). Up to 10% of cases fail to achieve reperfusion, often due to resistant clot characteristics, intracranial atherosclerotic disease (ICAD), or technical challenges. This study presents a case-series evaluating a bailout crossing technique-wireless "Tenzingplasty" using the Tenzing delivery catheter-for failed conventional EVT approaches with aspiration catheters and microwire crossing. METHODS: A retrospective review was performed between October 2025 and February 2026 at a single comprehensive stroke center, including adult patients who underwent EVT within 24 hours of stroke onset who had failed multiple aspiration and microwire crossing attempts. Wireless crossing with Tenzing catheter and subsequent Tenzingplasty was employed as a "last hope" technique to traverse and disrupt resistant occlusions in select cases (all cases included). Clinical, procedural, and outcome data were analyzed. RESULTS: All five cases achieved successful clot disruption and reperfusion, with 60% attaining complete (TICI 3) recanalization. Two patients required adjunctive stenting due to re-occlusion risk. No intraoperative complications, including vessel dissection or perforation, were observed. One patient experienced an asymptomatic subarachnoid hemorrhage. Functional outcomes were favorable: 80% achieving a 90-day modified Rankin Scale (mRS) ≤2 and no mortality reported. Mean NIHSS improved post-procedure. CONCLUSION: This is a proof-of-concept case-series is a feasibility report that wireless Tenzingplasty may offer a rescue strategy for resistant LVO, particularly in cases involving ICAD or failed wire access. Larger, controlled studies are needed to validate its safety and broader applicability.

title: A Twenty-Three-Year Single Center Experience with Elective Transcatheter Coil Embolization of Unruptured Splenic Artery Aneurysms.
abstract: PURPOSE: To determine the safety and efficacy of elective coil embolization for unruptured splenic artery aneurysms (SAA). MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective review of unruptured SAA treated endovascularly from October 2002 to January 2026 was performed. When the inflow vessel was embolized, primary technical success required both cessation of antegrade flow in the inflow vessel and absence of opacification of the aneurysm sac. When the sac alone was embolized or excluded, primary technical success required absence of sac opacification alone. Risk factors for major splenic infarct were assessed. RESULTS: A total of 156 unique aneurysms were treated in 130 patients. Mean aneurysm size was 2.4 ± 1.1 cm. Primary technical success was achieved in all but one (0.8%) patient over a mean follow-up of 4.1 ± 5.0 years. Secondary technical success was 100% and freedom from sac opacification was 95.1%. Reintervention was required in 4/122 (3.3%) patients with follow-up imaging, all of whom remained successfully treated. Major splenic infarct occurred in 17/122 (13.9%) patients, with portal hypertension as the only independent risk factor for major splenic infarct (adjusted OR 6.07; 95% CI 1.90-19.35; p = 0.002). Eight (6.2%) mortalities occurred, one (0.8%) within 30 days, all unrelated to SAA embolization. CONCLUSION: Elective coil embolization is a safe and effective treatment for SAA with robust rates of technical success, freedom from rupture, and freedom from sac enlargement.

Predictors of Clinical Outcomes Following Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt (TIPS) Placement: Comparing Baseline Liver Function Tests, Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) iterations, and the Freiburg Index of Post-TIPS Survival (FIPS).
abstract: PURPOSE: Accurate risk stratification is vital to optimize outcomes following Transjugular Intrahepatic Portosystemic Shunt (TIPS) placement. This study compared the 30-day prognostic performance of traditional laboratory values, Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) iterations (MELD, MELD-Na, MELD 3.0), and the Freiburg Index of Post-TIPS Survival (FIPS). MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this retrospective study, 192 adult patients were analyzed who underwent TIPS placement from 2018 to 2024 at a US quaternary center. The primary outcome was a 30-day composite endpoint of all-cause mortality or unplanned readmission. Scoring performance was evaluated using Spearman's correlation (Rho), ANOVA with Games-Howell post hoc testing, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. RESULTS: The 30-day composite endpoint occurred in 84 patients (42%; 37 deaths, 47 readmissions). Baseline albumin, creatinine, total bilirubin, and international normalized ratio correlated with the primary outcome (all p < 0.05). Among scoring systems, MELD 3.0 showed the strongest overall correlation with the examined outcome (Rho = 0.328, p < 0.001), closely followed by FIPS (Rho = 0.310, p < 0.001). A DeLong's test found no significant difference between MELD 3.0 and FIPS in predicting short-term composite outcomes. Post hoc testing showed FIPS significantly distinguished mortality from non-readmission (p < 0.001) but not between readmissions and uneventful recoveries (p = 0.228). ROC analysis identified a FIPS threshold of 1.115 for predicting 30-day mortality, yielding 94.1% specificity, 77.2% accuracy, and 46.4% sensitivity. CONCLUSION: In this cohort, no significant difference was found between MELD 3.0 and FIPS in predicting short-term composite outcomes. MELD 3.0 offers the strongest linear tracking for short-term composite outcomes, while a FIPS score > 1.115 might serve as a highly specific tool to identify candidates at risk for early mortality.

Does Pain Phenotype Influence Clinical Outcomes After Genicular Artery Embolization? Movement-evoked Pain Versus Pain at Rest: A Retrospective Comparative Study.
abstract: PURPOSE: Pain in knee osteoarthritis is heterogeneous and may influence clinical response to genicular artery embolization (GAE). This study aimed to compare pain reduction after GAE between patients with substantial pain at rest (SPAR) and those with predominantly movement-evoked pain (PMEP). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study included patients who underwent GAE for chronic knee pain and completed follow-up evaluations at 1 and 3 months. Patients were classified as SPAR when baseline VAS pain at rest was > 3 and as PMEP when VAS pain at rest was ≤ 3. Outcomes included changes in overall VAS pain score and patient-reported clinical improvement. RESULTS: Fifty-three patients were included. Individuals with SPAR showed significantly greater overall VAS reduction than those with PMEP at both 1 month (- 4.30 ± 2.85 vs. - 2.21 ± 3.49; p = 0.023) and 3 months (- 3.68 ± 2.92 vs. - 1.68 ± 3.33; p = 0.035). On univariable regression, SPAR predicted greater 3-month VAS reduction (coefficient - 1.99; 95% CI - 3.85 to - 0.14; p = 0.035). In multivariable analysis, SPAR remained an independent predictor of pain reduction at 3 months (coefficient - 3.74; 95% CI - 6.63 to - 0.85; p = 0.014). Higher baseline WOMAC score was also independently associated with greater improvement (p = 0.004), whereas Kellgren-Lawrence grade was not significant (p = 0.187). CONCLUSION: Pain phenotype may influence response to GAE. Patients with substantial pain at rest appear to benefit more than those with predominantly movement-evoked pain, supporting phenotype-based patient selection for GAE.

Arteriovenous Malformations as Neoplastic-Like Lesions: Molecular Underpinnings and Implications for the Interventional Radiologist.
abstract: Arteriovenous malformations (AVMs) are high-flow vascular anomalies traditionally treated as congenital structural lesions with embolization or surgical resection. However, recurrence after embolization alone exceeds 90%, underscoring incomplete understanding of their biology. Next-generation sequencing has identified somatic gain-of-function mutations in KRAS, MAP2K1, BRAF, and HRAS as drivers of sporadic AVMs. Confined to lesional endothelial cells, these mutations activate RAS/MAPK signaling and support a neoplastic-like rather than purely structural disease model. This has therapeutic implications: MEK inhibitors, particularly trametinib, have shown angiographic and clinical responses in refractory AVMs. Interventional radiologists can obtain draining vein liquid-biopsy samples during embolization for molecular genotyping; embolization may increase circulating cell-free DNA yield. This review summarizes the molecular rationale, targeted therapy evidence, and integration of genotyping into embolization workflows to enable combined treatment strategies.Level of Evidence: No level of evidence assigned (Review Article).

summary.results: 동맥-정맥루(AVM)의 드물게 발생하는(sporadic) 사례에서 KRAS, MAP2K1, BRAF, HRAS 유전자의 gain-of-function 돌연변이가 발견되었으며, 이는 RAS/MAPK 신호 전달 경로를 활성화시켜 종양과 유사한 특징을 나타냅니다. MEK 억제제(trametinib)는 난치성 동맥-정맥루(AVM)에서 혈관 영상학적(angiographic) 및 임상적(clinical) 반응을 보였습니다. 화학색전술(embolization) 시 배액정맥(draining vein)에서 액체 생검(liquid biopsy)을 통해 분자 유전자형(molecular genotyping) 분석이 가능하며, 화학색전술(embolization)은 세포 자유 DNA(cell-free DNA) 수율을 증가시킬 수 있습니다. 화학색전술(embolization)만 시행할 경우 재발률이 90%를 초과합니다.
summary.implication: 동맥-정맥루(AVM)를 단순한 선천성 혈관 기형이 아닌 종양과 유사한 병변으로 간주하고, 분자 유전자형 분석을 통해 표적 치료(MEK 억제제)를 병행하는 통합 치료 전략을 고려해야 합니다. 인터벤션 영상의학 전문의는 화학색전술(embolization) 과정에서 액체 생검(liquid biopsy)을 통해 분자 정보를 얻고 치료 전략을 수립하는 데 중요한 역할을 할 수 있습니다.

Access Vessel Patency After Endovascular Therapy via Tibiopedal Access in Patients With Lower Extremity Artery Disease.
abstract: PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate the access vessel patency after endovascular therapy performed via tibiopedal access. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This was a retrospective, single-center, observational study. Patients who underwent endovascular therapy via tibiopedal access with sheath insertion were enrolled. The primary outcome was loss of access vessel patency defined as access vessel occlusion or stenosis with a peak systolic velocity ratio > 2.4 on duplex ultrasound at 6 months. Multivariate logistic regression analysis was performed to identify the predictors of access vessel patency loss, with hemodialysis, severely calcified access vessel and sheath-to-artery ratio included as covariates. RESULTS: A total of 95 limbs in 91 patients were included in this study, and loss of access vessel patency was observed in 22 limbs (23.1%). Multivariate logistic regression analysis demonstrated that sheath-to-artery ratio was the only independent predictor (odds ratio: 1.493, 95% confidence interval: 1.130-1.976; p = 0.005). The receiver operating characteristic curve analysis revealed that the optimal cutoff value of sheath-to-artery ratio for predicting loss of access vessel patency was 1.08, with an area under the curve of 0.723. In this cohort, the 2-year freedom from major adverse limb events were 98.6% (95% CI: 90.8-99.8%), and no major amputation occurred. CONCLUSION: The present study demonstrated a relatively high incidence of loss of access vessel patency after endovascular therapy via tibiopedal access, although this was not associated with an increase in major adverse limb events. A larger sheath-to-artery ratio was identified as an independent predictor of loss of access vessel patency.

title: Technique, Safety and Adoption of Genicular Artery Embolization for Knee Osteoarthritis: A Nationwide Analysis of the German Quality-Assurance Registry.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the nationwide adoption of genicular artery embolization (GAE) in Germany and to describe patient selection, technique, safety and radiation dose. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed procedures recorded in the quality-assurance registry of the German Society for Interventional Radiology and Minimally Invasive Therapy (DeGIR), from January 2024 to December 2025. Technical success, entered per procedure, was defined as subjective adequate devascularization of the synovial blush. Complications were graded using the modified CIRSE classification, and radiation exposure was expressed as dose-area product (DAP) and fluoroscopy time. The analysis was primarily descriptive. RESULTS: Overall, 2335 procedures in 2209 patients across 109 centers in 15 federal states were recorded (median age 67 years, IQR 59-77; 57% female; prior total knee arthroplasty (TKA) in 300, 13%). Annual volume rose from 579 procedures in 2024 to 1,756 in 2025, and the embolic agent shifted from permanent (40-21%) toward temporary microspheres (4-29%). Center-reported technical success was 93% (87% in 2024, 94% in 2025). Eleven complications were recorded (0.5%), all CIRSE grade 1-3, with no permanent sequelae; none were recorded in 2024. Median DAP was 1536 cGy cm2 (IQR 731-3048) and median fluoroscopy time 24 min (IQR 16-34). CONCLUSION: During rapid nationwide adoption, GAE was performed for osteoarthritis-related and post-TKA pain with low radiation dose and high center-reported technical success across centers of all volumes, supporting its feasibility in routine practice. The complication rate is a lower limit, as the registry is not designed for complication surveillance.

Cost Analysis of Percutaneous Segmentectomy Versus Chemoembolisation and Radioembolisation in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Retrospective Multicentre Cohort Study.
abstract: PURPOSE: To compare the costs of percutaneous segmentectomy, a single-session combination of transarterial embolisation and microwave ablation, against chemoembolisation and radioembolisation for hepatocellular carcinoma. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Retrospective cost analysis of 66 patients treated with percutaneous segmentectomy at five Italian centres, using bottom-up micro-costing. Comparator costs were derived from published Italian per-session costs multiplied by mean sessions per patient, and survival from published curves. A partitioned survival model estimated life-years and incremental net monetary benefit at 50,000 euros per life-year. RESULTS: Procedural cost per treated patient was 6331 euros for percutaneous segmentectomy, 9792 euros for chemoembolisation (mean 2.94 sessions), and 21,673 euros for radioembolisation (1.52 sessions). At 24 months, percutaneous segmentectomy had lower total cost and a small life-year deficit (incremental cost-effectiveness ratio approximately 70,800 euros per life-year versus chemoembolisation and 57,500 versus radioembolisation, both above threshold). This life-year-adjusted advantage reversed versus chemoembolisation, and became neutral versus radioembolisation, in a worst-case sensitivity analysis, and reversed against both when transplantation costs for the eight transplanted patients (19%) were attributed to percutaneous segmentectomy alone. CONCLUSION: In this exploratory analysis, percutaneous segmentectomy appeared to have a lower procedural cost per treated patient than chemoembolisation and radioembolisation, mainly because it is delivered in a single session. However, because costing routes, cohorts, and survival sources were not equivalent and the life-year-adjusted comparison was not robust, no formal cost superiority can be established. These hypothesis-generating findings require confirmation in prospective, matched studies. LEVEL OF EVIDENCE: Level 4, Retrospective Cohort Study with Historical Comparators.

Multistage Preclinical Evaluation of MRI-Guided Stenting for Coarctation of the Aorta using in vitro and Porcine Models.
abstract: PURPOSE: This study evaluated the technical and procedural feasibility of MRI-guided stent implantation for CoA using a structured multistage preclinical evaluation protocol. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A commercially available MR Conditional guidewire and dedicated research prototypes comprising nitinol stents, delivery systems, and balloon catheters were assessed in a three-stage protocol. Device visibility was evaluated in a standardized water phantom at 1.5 T and 3.0 T. In a polymer-based CoA vessel phantom, 10 stent implantations were performed by novices (n = 6) and experts (n = 4), with four separate expert-led balloon dilatations. MRI-guided stent implantation was subsequently performed in five porcine models. RESULTS: All devices were visible at both field strengths, with lateral artifact widths of 5.3-7.8 mm for the guidewire, 20.9-38.5 mm for the stent delivery system, 13.1-19.9 mm for the expanded stents, and 17.4-30.5 mm for the balloon catheter. Phantom stenting duration was 10.2 ± 7.2 mins for novices and 6.2 ± 2.7 mins for experts. MRI-guided stent implantation was successfully performed in all five animals, with a mean duration of 13.6 ± 7.5 mins. In one animal, balloon post-dilatation was additionally performed as a procedural proof of concept. CONCLUSION: MRI-guided stent implantation for CoA is feasible within a structured multistage preclinical evaluation protocol and supports further clinical translation of radiation-free endovascular treatment.

Balloon-Occlusion Versus End-Hole Transarterial Chemoembolization for Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of balloon-occluded transarterial chemoembolization (B-TACE) compared with conventional (cTACE) and drug-eluting-bead transarterial chemoembolization (DEB-TACE) in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted following PRISMA guidelines and registered in PROSPERO. PubMed, Scopus, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched to 8 February 2026 for randomized and observational studies comparing B-TACE with cTACE or DEB-TACE. Tumor response (mRECIST), overall survival, and adverse events were pooled using random-effects models; risk of bias was assessed with established tools. RESULTS: Nine studies (one randomized, eight observational; 1534 patients) were included. Complete response, objective response, disease control, and progressive disease did not differ significantly between groups, with moderate-to-substantial heterogeneity. Baseline tumors were larger in the balloon-occluded group (mean difference 4.34 mm; 95% CI 1.18- 7.50; p = 0.014). Exploratory study-level analyses suggested greater relative B-TACE effects with larger tumors, particularly for complete response and disease control.Overall survival favored B-TACE in the two studies with extractable hazard ratios (HR 0.41; 95% CI 0.23 to 0.73; p = 0.002). Post-treatment liver enzymes, bilirubin, fever, and post-embolization syndrome did not differ significantly. CONCLUSION: No statistically significant differences in imaging response or safety were observed between intervention and comparator groups, while B-TACE was associated with a signal toward improved overall survival despite larger baseline tumors. Exploratory findings suggested that larger tumor size may be associated with a greater relative B-TACE effect. Given the limited evidence, these findings require confirmation in randomized controlled trials.

summary.title_ko: 간세포암종에서 풍선 폐쇄술을 이용한 간동맥화학색전술(B-TACE) 대 전형적인 간동맥화학색전술(cTACE) 및 약물 방출 비드를 이용한 간동맥화학색전술(DEB-TACE)의 효과 및 안전성 비교: 체계적 검토 및 메타분석

summary.subjects: 대상 환자 N=1534 (무작위 배정 연구 1건, 관찰 연구 8건)

summary.results: 종양 반응(mRECIST), 전체 생존율, 부작용 측면에서 B-TACE와 cTACE 또는 DEB-TACE 간에 유의미한 차이가 없었으나, B-TACE 그룹의 기저 종양 크기가 더 컸음 (평균 차이 4.34 mm; 95% CI 1.18-7.50; p = 0.014). 전체 생존율은 두 건의 위험비(HR) 추출이 가능한 연구에서 B-TACE 그룹에서 더 유리했음 (HR 0.41; 95% CI 0.23 to 0.73; p = 0.002). 간 효소, 빌리루빈, 발열, 색전 후 증후군 등의 치료 후 발생률에 유의미한 차이는 없었음.
summary.implication: B-TACE는 더 큰 기저 종양을 가진 환자에서도 전체 생존율 개선 가능성을 보여주지만, 추가적인 무작위 배정 임상 시험을 통해 확인이 필요하다.
summary.detailed_results: 종양 반응(mRECIST) 측면에서 완전 반응, 객관적 반응, 질병 조절, 진행성 질환 간에 유의미한 차이가 없었으며, 이질성이 높게 나타남. B-TACE 그룹에서 기저 종양 크기가 더 컸으며, 특히 큰 종양에서 완전 반응 및 질병 조절에 대한 B-TACE 효과가 더 컸을 가능성을 시사하는 탐색적 분석 결과가 있었음. 치료 후 간 효소, 빌리루빈, 발열, 색전 후 증후군 등의 부작용 발생률에 유의미한 차이는 없었음. 전체 생존율에 대한 위험비(HR)는 두 건의 연구에서 추출 가능했으며, B-TACE 그룹에서 HR 0.41 (95% CI 0.23 to 0.73; p = 0.002)으로 나타남.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 다양한 연구 디자인(무작위 배정 연구 1건, 관찰 연구 8건)을 포함하고 있어 이질성이 높을 수 있으며, 결과 해석에 주의가 필요하다. 또한, 제한된 수의 연구를 기반으로 하므로, 결과의 일반화 가능성에 한계가 있다. 탐색적 분석 결과는 추가적인 연구를 통해 확인되어야 한다.
summary.clinical_application: 간세포암종 환자에게 간동맥화학색전술(TACE)을 시행할 때, 특히 종양 크기가 큰 환자에게 B-TACE를 고려할 수 있지만, 추가적인 무작위 배정 임상 시험을 통해 효과를 확인해야 한다. B-TACE의 잠재적 이점을 고려하여 환자 선택 및 치료 계획 수립에 활용할 수 있다.

Integrating Histotripsy into Chemoimmunotherapy for Oligometastatic Recurrent Extrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma: Case Report.
abstract: The management of advanced, recurrent extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma has shifted toward prolonged systemic therapy including immune checkpoint inhibition. Incorporating local treatment for oligometastatic or oligoprogressive disease without interrupting systemic therapy remains challenging. Conventional liver-directed therapies frequently require a chemotherapy break. Histotripsy is a noninvasive, non-thermal, non-ionizing modality that permits continuation of systemic therapy. This case presents a 71-year-old woman with recurrent extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma who developed multifocal hepatic metastases while receiving gemcitabine and durvalumab. She was deemed not a candidate for further radiation therapy or other locoregional therapies; thus, nine of ten hepatic lesions were treated with histotripsy in a single session. This case highlights the possibility of integrating histotripsy with chemoimmunotherapy by providing short-term local control of oligometastatic progression without the need to interrupt systemic treatment.Level of Evidence: Level 4, Case Report.

Endovascular Therapy for Femoropopliteal Artery Lesions Involving the Popliteal Artery: 1-Year Outcomes from a Real-World Multicenter Registry.
abstract: PURPOSE: To evaluate real-world outcomes of endovascular treatment for femoropopliteal lesions involving the popliteal artery and, in a post-hoc exploratory analysis, assess whether anatomical location (P3 vs. P1/P2 segments) was associated with clinical decision-making and prognosis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We conducted a retrospective, post-hoc analysis of 946 patients from the prospective PROMISING registry. For this exploratory analysis, patients were stratified according to distal (P3) versus proximal/mid (P1/P2) popliteal artery involvement. Predictors of stent implantation and clinical decision pathways were compared across groups. RESULTS: Overall procedural success was 98.5%, and the 12-month freedom from major adverse events (MAE), defined as a composite of all-cause mortality, major amputation, or clinically driven target lesion revascularization, was 80.1%. Multivariable analysis indicated P3 involvement independently predicted reduced stent implantation (OR 0.66, 95% CI 0.46-0.95, p = 0.027). For vessel preparation, the P3 group more frequently utilized plain old balloon angioplasty (POBA, 67.8% vs. 54.8%, p < 0.001) rather than directional atherectomy or specialty balloons. Despite a lower stent implantation rate and greater use of POBA, 12-month freedom from MAE was comparable between the P3 and P1/P2 groups (78.0% vs. 81.2%, p = 0.481). CONCLUSION: In this post-hoc analysis of real-world registry data, popliteal lesion location was associated with differences in operator treatment strategies. P3 involvement was associated with less frequent stent implantation and greater use of plain balloon angioplasty, while 1-year clinical outcomes were comparable between the P3 and P1/P2 groups. These exploratory findings require external validation before they can be used to inform clinical treatment strategies. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier NCT04826705 (Registered on March 29, 2021).

summary.title_ko: 슬개동맥 관여를 동반한 대퇴-경골 동맥 병변에 대한 혈관내 치료: 실제 데이터 기반 다기관 등록 연구에서의 1년 결과

summary.implication: 슬개동맥 병변 위치에 따라 치료 전략이 달라질 수 있으며, P3 병변의 경우 스텐트 이식률이 낮고 POBA 사용이 증가하는 경향이 있지만, 1년 임상 결과는 유사하다. 이러한 결과는 임상 치료 전략 수립에 앞서 외부 검증이 필요하다.

title: First-Line Thrombectomy for Acute Intracranial Atherosclerotic Stenosis-Related Vertebrobasilar Artery Occlusion: Stent Retriever-Based Versus Contact Aspiration Thrombectomy Strategies.
abstract: PURPOSE: To compare procedural and clinical outcomes of first-line contact aspiration thrombectomy (CAT) versus a stent retriever-based strategy in acute intracranial atherosclerotic stenosis (ICAS)-related vertebrobasilar artery occlusion (VBAO). MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective two-center study included consecutive patients with acute ICAS-related VBAO treated between 2019 and 2024. Patients were classified by first-line strategy as CAT or an SRT-based strategy comprising stent retriever thrombectomy alone or with aspiration assistance. Primary outcomes were first-pass recanalization (FPR; modified Thrombolysis in Cerebral Infarction grade ≥ 2b after one device pass) and 90-day favorable functional outcome (modified Rankin Scale score 0-3). Multivariable regression was used for outcome comparisons, with inverse probability weighting (IPW) as a sensitivity analysis. RESULTS: Among 129 patients, 38 received CAT and 91 received an SRT-based strategy. FPR was higher with the SRT-based strategy than with CAT (74.7% vs. 52.6%; adjusted odds ratio [aOR], 2.66; 95% CI, 1.15-6.16; p = 0.022). The 90-day favorable outcome did not differ significantly (48.4% vs. 36.8%; aOR, 1.69; 95% CI, 0.71-4.02; p = 0.235). In the primary adjusted analysis, the SRT-based strategy was associated with lower 90-day mortality (19.8% vs. 34.2%; aOR, 0.37; 95% CI, 0.15-0.96; p = 0.041), fewer strategy switches (1.1% vs. 34.2%; p < 0.001), and shorter puncture-to-recanalization time (63.0 vs. 73.5 min; p = 0.003). IPW supported these procedural advantages, whereas clinical outcome differences were nonsignificant. CONCLUSION: In acute ICAS-related VBAO, a first-line SRT-based strategy was associated with better procedural performance than CAT, including higher first-pass recanalization, fewer strategy switches, and shorter puncture-to-recanalization time.

title: Procedural Micro-Costing of Single-Room Transcatheter CT Hepatic Angiography for Microwave Liver Ablation.
abstract: PURPOSE: To quantify the resource use and procedural costs attributable to transcatheter CT hepatic angiography during single-room computed tomography-guided microwave ablation of liver tumours. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A prospective bottom-up micro-costing analysis was conducted from the UK National Health Service perspective. Resource utilisation data were collected from 35 consecutive patients undergoing hepatic angiography-assisted microwave ablation in a single-room equipped with a standard computed tomography scanner and a mobile C-arm. Unit costs were identified using National Health Service reference costs and the Personal Social Services Research Unit databases. Per-procedure costs incorporated staff time, equipment and consumables, and imaging-related capital costs. RESULTS: Median costs were £4,499 (£2,361-8,001) for the ablation component and £1,142 (£929-1,584) for hepatic angiography, with a median combined procedure cost, calculated independently, of £5,689 (£3,533-9,296). The hepatic angiography component was equivalent to 25.4% of the median ablation-component cost. Among the sensitivity scenarios tested, angiography duration had the greatest influence on its incremental cost, producing estimates of £929-1,584. CONCLUSION: Hepatic angiography adds a measurable incremental cost to computed tomography-guided microwave ablation. These results provide a foundation for prospective studies evaluating whether improved intraprocedural assessment translates into reduced re-intervention and improved cost-effectiveness. LEVEL OF EVIDENCE: Level 4, case series.

summary.results: 간동맥 조영술(Hepatic Angiography) 관련 중간 비용은 £1,142 (£929-1,584)였으며, 미세파 열치료(Microwave Ablation) 관련 중간 비용은 £4,499 (£2,361-8,001)였다. 두 시술을 합산한 중간 비용은 £5,689 (£3,533-9,296)로, 간동맥 조영술(Hepatic Angiography)은 미세파 열치료(Microwave Ablation) 비용의 25.4%에 해당했다.
summary.implication: 간동맥 조영술(Hepatic Angiography)은 간 종양 미세파 열치료(Microwave Ablation)에 추가적인 비용을 발생시킨다. 향후 시술 중 평가 개선이 재시술 감소 및 비용 효율성 향상으로 이어질 수 있는지 평가하기 위한 연구의 기반을 제공한다.
summary.detailed_results: 조영술(Angiography) 지속 시간이 비용에 가장 큰 영향을 미쳤으며, £929-1,584의 비용 추정치를 나타냈다. 비용은 staff time, 장비 및 소모품, 영상 관련 자본 비용을 포함하여 계산되었다.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 단일 기관에서 수행된 증례 연구(Case Series)로, 연구 대상이 제한적이며 일반화 가능성이 낮을 수 있다. 또한, 영국 국립 보건 서비스(National Health Service)의 기준 비용을 사용했기 때문에 다른 국가에서는 비용이 다를 수 있다. 추가적으로, 시술의 성공 여부나 장기적인 결과에 대한 데이터는 포함되지 않았다.
summary.clinical_application: 간동맥 조영술(Hepatic Angiography)의 비용 효율성을 높이기 위해 시술 시간 단축 및 불필요한 검사 감소를 위한 노력이 필요하다. 또한, 시술 중 실시간 평가를 통해 재시술을 줄이고 환자 결과를 개선하는 방법을 모색해야 한다.

Same-Day Radioembolization for Large Hepatocellular Carcinoma (≥ 5 cm) Using Yttrium-90 Resin Microspheres: Protocol for a Multicenter Prospective Registry Study (ISTAR-01).
abstract: PURPOSE: This study aims to evaluate the technical feasibility of same-day yttrium-90 (Y-90) radioembolization in patients with large hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) (≥ 5 cm) who are predicted to have a low lung shunt fraction (LSF) based on imaging features. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This prospective, multicenter, open-label, single-arm registry study will enroll patients with large HCC without imaging features suggestive of high LSF. Eligible patients will undergo same-day planning angiography, technetium-99 m macroaggregated albumin (99mTc-MAA) scintigraphy, and Y-90 radioembolization using resin microspheres. Key eligibility criteria include tumor size ≥ 5 cm, Child-Pugh class A liver function, and absence of imaging findings associated with elevated LSF. Imaging indicators of high LSF include hepatic vein invasion, early hepatic vein enhancement, transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt, and dysmorphic intratumoral vessels ≥ 3 mm. The primary endpoint is the proportion of patients successfully undergoing same-day treatment among those scheduled. Secondary endpoints include objective response rate (ORR), progression-free survival (PFS), overall survival (OS), and treatment-related toxicity. STATISTICS: A total of 139 patients will be enrolled to estimate feasibility, assuming a success rate of 90% with a 5% margin of error at a 95% confidence level. ORR will be compared using the chi-square test, while PFS and OS will be evaluated using the Kaplan-Meier method and compared using the log-rank test. EXPECTED GAIN OF KNOWLEDGE: This study will provide prospective evidence regarding the feasibility and clinical outcomes of same-day radioembolization in large HCC. GOV IDENTIFIER: NCT06944483.

summary.title_ko: ≥5cm 대형 간세포암 환자의 당일 Y-90 방사성 미세구체 방사색전술(Radioembolization)의 기술적 타당성 평가: 전향적 다기관 등록 연구 (ISTAR-01)
summary.one_line: 본 연구는 영상 검사상 폐로의 혈류 우회(lung shunt) 가능성이 낮은 ≥5cm 대형 간세포암 환자에서 당일 계획 혈관조영술, 99mTc-MAA 스캔, Y-90 방사성 미세구체 방사색전술을 시행하는 기술적 타당성을 평가하는 전향적 다기관 등록 연구입니다.
summary.design: 전향적(Prospective), 다기관(Multicenter), 오픈 라벨(Open-label), 단일군(Single-arm) 등록 연구(Registry Study)
summary.subjects: ≥5cm 대형 간세포암 환자, N=139 (기술적 타당성 평가를 위해)
summary.intervention: Y-90 방사성 미세구체 방사색전술(Radioembolization) (레진 미세구체 사용), 당일 계획 혈관조영술(planning angiography), 99mTc-MAA 스캔(scintigraphy)
summary.results: 주요 목표는 예정된 환자 중 당일 치료를 성공적으로 완료한 환자의 비율을 평가하는 것입니다.  기술적 타당성 성공률을 90%로 가정하고 5%의 오차 범위, 95% 신뢰 수준에서 139명의 환자를 등록합니다.
summary.implication: 본 연구는 대형 간세포암 환자에서 당일 방사성 미세구체 방사색전술의 타당성과 임상 결과를 평가하여 실제 임상 적용 가능성을 제시할 것입니다.
summary.detailed_results: 2차 목표는 객관적 반응률(ORR), 무진행 생존 기간(PFS), 전체 생존 기간(OS), 치료 관련 독성 등을 평가합니다. 객관적 반응률(ORR)은 카이제곱 검정(chi-square test)으로 비교하고, 무진행 생존 기간(PFS)과 전체 생존 기간(OS)은 캡란-마이어 방법(Kaplan-Meier method)으로 평가하고 로그 랭크 검정(log-rank test)으로 비교합니다.  고 폐 혈류 우회(LSF) 위험 요인으로는 간맥 침범, 조기 간맥 강화, 경동맥-간정맥 단락(transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt), 3mm 이상의 비정형 종내 혈관 등이 있습니다.
summary.critique: 본 연구는 등록 연구(registry study)라는 특성상 선택 편향(selection bias)의 가능성이 있으며, 대조군(control group)이 없어 Y-90 방사성 미세구체 방사색전술의 효과를 직접적으로 평가하기는 어렵습니다.  또한, 99mTc-MAA 스캔을 통한 폐 혈류 우회(lung shunt) 예측의 정확성에 대한 검증이 필요합니다.
summary.clinical_application: 본 연구 결과는 폐 혈류 우회(lung shunt) 위험이 낮은 ≥5cm 대형 간세포암 환자에게 당일 Y-90 방사성 미세구체 방사색전술을 시행하는 것이 기술적으로 타당하며, 향후 임상 적용을 위한 근거를 제공할 수 있습니다.
